  "new_string": "def run_bf16_flashinfer_sparse(q, K_bf16, V_bf16, SPT, SSL, B):\n    \"\"\"bf16 flashinfer paged decode fed sparse_page_table as token-level indices.\n    This is the exact path SALA uses today (sparse_page_table -> flashinfer\n    BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper w/ page_size=1).\n    \"\"\"\n    from flashinfer import BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper\n    # Convert SPT/SSL to flashinfer sparse format. Page-size=1 so \"page\" = \"token slot\".\n    # We need to treat each (b, kv_head) row independently -> 2× virtual batches like SALA does.\n    # Repeat K/V buffer per kv head layout: flashinfer wants [num_pages, page_size=1, H_kv, D]\n    N_slots, H_kv, D = K_bf16.shape\n    K_vw = K_bf16.view(N_slots, 1, H_kv, D)\n    V_vw = V_bf16.view(N_slots, 1, H_kv, D)\n\n    bs_virt = B * 2\n    SSL_cpu = SSL.cpu()\n    total = int(SSL_cpu.sum().item())\n    kv_indptr = torch.zeros(bs_virt + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)\n    kv_indptr[1:] = torch.cumsum(SSL, dim=0)\n    kv_indices = torch.empty(total, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)\n    off = 0\n    for row in range(bs_virt):\n        L = int(SSL_cpu[row].item())\n        kv_indices[off:off + L] = SPT[row, :L]\n        off += L\n    kv_last_page_len = torch.ones(bs_virt, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)\n\n    workspace = torch.empty(256 * 1024 * 1024, dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    wrapper = BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper(workspace, \"NHD\", use_tensor_cores=True)\n    # q shape for flashinfer: [num_qo, H_q_per_virtual_batch, D].  We split H_q into 2\n    # virtual batches (per head-group), each with H_q/2 heads.\n    q_virt = q.reshape(B, 2, NUM_Q_HEADS // 2, HEAD_DIM).reshape(bs_virt, NUM_Q_HEADS // 2, HEAD_DIM)\n    wrapper.begin_forward(\n        kv_indptr, kv_indices, kv_last_page_len,\n        NUM_Q_HEADS // 2, H_kv // 2 if H_kv > 1 else 1, HEAD_DIM, 1,\n        q_data_type=q.dtype, kv_data_type=K_bf16.dtype, non_blocking=True,\n    )\n    # Squeeze each virtual batch to its own kv_head slice\n    # Simpler: run twice, one per head group, to get closer to SALA's head-group split\n    outs = []\n    for kvh in range(H_kv):\n        K_slice = K_bf16[:, kvh:kvh+1, :].contiguous()\n        V_slice = V_bf16[:, kvh:kvh+1, :].contiguous()\n        # build per-kv-head indptr/indices\n        ssl_h = SSL[kvh::H_kv]\n        spt_h = SPT[kvh::H_kv]\n        indptr_h = torch.zeros(B + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)\n        indptr_h[1:] = torch.cumsum(ssl_h, dim=0)\n        total_h = int(ssl_h.sum().item())\n        idx_h = torch.empty(total_h, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)\n        off = 0\n        for b in range(B):\n            L = int(ssl_h[b].item())\n            idx_h[off:off + L] = spt_h[b, :L]\n            off += L\n        lpl_h = torch.ones(B, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)\n        wr = BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper(workspace, \"NHD\", use_tensor_cores=True)\n        wr.begin_forward(\n            indptr_h, idx_h, lpl_h,\n            Q_PER_KV, 1, HEAD_DIM, 1,\n            q_data_type=q.dtype, kv_data_type=K_bf16.dtype, non_blocking=True,\n        )\n        K_in = K_slice.view(-1, 1, 1, HEAD_DIM)    # [N_slots, page=1, H_kv=1, D]\n        V_in = V_slice.view(-1, 1, 1, HEAD_DIM)\n        q_h = q[:, kvh * Q_PER_KV:(kvh + 1) * Q_PER_KV, :].contiguous()  # [B, Q_PER_KV, D]\n        o = wr.forward(q_h, (K_in, V_in), sm_scale=1.0 / (HEAD_DIM ** 0.5))\n        outs.append(o)\n    # Stitch back\n    out = q.clone()\n    for kvh in range(H_kv):\n        out[:, kvh * Q_PER_KV:(kvh + 1) * Q_PER_KV, :] = outs[kvh]\n    return out\n\n\ndef main():\n    B = int(os.environ.get(\"BENCH_B\", \"8\"))\n    SP = int(os.environ.get(\"BENCH_SP\", \"4096\"))\n    print(\"=\" * 72)\n    print(f\"Device: {torch.cuda.get_device_name()}\")\n    print(f\"B={B} num_sparse_tokens={SP} H_q={NUM_Q_HEADS} H_kv={NUM_KV_HEADS} D={HEAD_DIM}\")\n    print(\"=\" * 72)\n\n    q, K_bf16, V_bf16, SPT, SSL = setup(B, SP)\n\n    K_pack, K_sf, inv_gsf_k = quantize_kv_nvfp4(K_bf16)\n    V_pack, V_sf, inv_gsf_v = quantize_kv_nvfp4(V_bf16)\n\n    # ---- Reference: pytorch bf16 sparse attention ----\n    ref = ref_sparse_attention(q, K_bf16, V_bf16, SPT, SSL)\n\n    # ---- Triton NVFP4 ----\n    tri = run_triton(q, K_pack, V_pack, K_sf, V_sf, SPT, SSL, B, inv_gsf_k, inv_gsf_v)\n    cos_t = F.cosine_similarity(tri.flatten().float(), ref.flatten().float(), dim=0).item()\n    mad_t = (tri.float() - ref.float()).abs().max().item()\n\n    # ---- bf16 flashinfer sparse baseline ----\n    try:\n        fi = run_bf16_flashinfer_sparse(q, K_bf16, V_bf16, SPT, SSL, B)\n        cos_fi = F.cosine_similarity(fi.flatten().float(), ref.flatten().float(), dim=0).item()\n    except Exception as e:\n        print(f\"[bf16-fi]  setup FAILED: {type(e).__name__}: {e}\")\n        fi = None\n        cos_fi = float(\"nan\")\n\n    print(f\"[triton-nvfp4] cos={cos_t:.4f}  max_diff={mad_t:.4f}\")\n    print(f\"[bf16-flashinfer] cos={cos_fi:.4f}\")\n\n    if cos_t < 0.95:\n        print(\"*** triton correctness FAIL ***\")\n        return\n\n    # ---- Bench ----\n    def tri_fn():\n        return run_triton(q, K_pack, V_pack, K_sf, V_sf, SPT, SSL, B, inv_gsf_k, inv_gsf_v)\n    t_tri = bench_fn(tri_fn)\n    print(f\"[triton-nvfp4]    latency = {t_tri:.2f} us\")\n\n    if fi is not None:\n        def fi_fn():\n            return run_bf16_flashinfer_sparse(q, K_bf16, V_bf16, SPT, SSL, B)\n        t_fi = bench_fn(fi_fn, iters=30, warmup=3)  # fi setup is heavy, fewer iters\n        print(f\"[bf16-flashinfer] latency = {t_fi:.2f} us (includes wrapper setup)\")"

正确性全部 0.99+，性能有两个观察：
1. B scaling 极好（B=1/8/32 在 SP=4096 下都是 700us，说明 kernel 把 SM 用满了早得很）—— 但**小 B 利用率不足**（B=1 只产生 2 个 program，SM=84 大量空闲）
2. flashinfer baseline 带 setup 不公平

先修 baseline 让 forward 单独测，再同 shape 对比。

{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/user_4813494d/openbmb/bench/bench_nvfp4_sparse_decode_triton.py",
  "old_string": "def run_bf16_flashinfer_sparse(q, K_bf16, V_bf16, SPT, SSL, B):",
  "new_string": "def make_bf16_flashinfer_closure(q, K_bf16, V_bf16, SPT, SSL, B):\n    \"\"\"Build a flashinfer sparse decode closure whose forward() call is the only\n    thing measured (wrapper setup + index-build is one-shot, matching prod).\"\"\"\n    from flashinfer import BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper\n    H_kv = K_bf16.shape[1]\n    workspace = torch.empty(256 * 1024 * 1024, dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    per_head = []\n    for kvh in range(H_kv):\n        ssl_h = SSL[kvh::H_kv]\n        spt_h = SPT[kvh::H_kv]\n        total_h = int(ssl_h.sum().item())\n        indptr = torch.zeros(B + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)\n        indptr[1:] = torch.cumsum(ssl_h, dim=0)\n        idx = torch.empty(total_h, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)\n        off = 0\n        for b in range(B):\n            L = int(ssl_h[b].item())\n            idx[off:off + L] = spt_h[b, :L]\n            off += L\n        lpl = torch.ones(B, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)\n        wr = BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper(workspace, \"NHD\", use_tensor_cores=True)\n        wr.begin_forward(indptr, idx, lpl, Q_PER_KV, 1, HEAD_DIM, 1,\n                         q_data_type=q.dtype, kv_data_type=K_bf16.dtype, non_blocking=True)\n        K_in = K_bf16[:, kvh:kvh+1, :].contiguous().view(-1, 1, 1, HEAD_DIM)\n        V_in = V_bf16[:, kvh:kvh+1, :].contiguous().view(-1, 1, 1, HEAD_DIM)\n        q_h  = q[:, kvh * Q_PER_KV:(kvh + 1) * Q_PER_KV, :].contiguous()\n        per_head.append((wr, K_in, V_in, q_h))\n\n    def forward_only():\n        outs = []\n        for wr, K_in, V_in, q_h in per_head:\n            outs.append(wr.forward(q_h, (K_in, V_in), sm_scale=1.0 / (HEAD_DIM ** 0.5)))\n        return outs\n\n    # one warm call to get a reference output for correctness\n    ref_outs = forward_only()\n    out = q.clone()\n    for kvh, o in enumerate(ref_outs):\n        out[:, kvh * Q_PER_KV:(kvh + 1) * Q_PER_KV, :] = o\n    return out, forward_only\n\n\ndef run_bf16_flashinfer_sparse(q, K_bf16, V_bf16, SPT, SSL, B):"
}

## 我刚刚在做什么

写了 Triton NVFP4 sparse decode kernel → 拿到 cos_sim 0.99 的正确性 → 然后**用 bf16 flashinfer 做 baseline 对比**了性能。

**这个对比错在根上**：
- 生产 baseline 是 `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_e5m2`，**不是 bf16**
- 我该比的是 **NVFP4 triton vs fp8 flashinfer**
- 理论上 NVFP4 比 fp8 只省 2× 带宽（0.56 byte vs 1 byte），不是比 bf16 省 4×
- 我拿 bf16 数据算"加速空间"本身就是错的

## 数据真正说明什么

放在正确 baseline 下：
- **生产 fp8 flashinfer sparse decode**：估 ~15us（bf16 23us 的 65%）
- **我写的 naive Triton NVFP4**：700us（比 fp8 慢 **~45×**）
- **NVFP4 roofline**：10us（要超过 fp8，理论上限）

要拿到 NVFP4 相对 fp8 的 2× 理论加速，需要把 Triton 从 700us **压到 <8us**。这需要把 naive single-pass 改成 split-KV + TMA + tile + 手工 tensor core 流水——**几周工程级别**，还不一定能超过 flashinfer 多年优化的 C++ 实现。

## 真正的问题

**在 SALA 的 sparse path 上，自写 Triton kernel 打赢 flashinfer fp8 是不现实的个人工程**。NVFP4 本身不是带宽魔法——它的收益来源是 kernel 内 on-the-fly dequant，而 flashinfer fp8 也是这么做的。两者差距只有 0.56 vs 1 byte 的 HBM 读取，却要用一个自写 kernel 对抗多年优化的 C++ kernel。

优胜者能做 NVFP4 KV，极大概率是因为他们**不走 sparse attention**（模型不一样，或者改了模型走 dense + xqa），而不是他们手写了超过 flashinfer 的 Triton kernel。

## 我的判断

离线数据已经足够做决策——**这条路对我们不划算**。继续深挖 Triton 优化是把几周工程赌在"也许能超过 flashinfer"这件不确定的事上。

要不要我：
- **放弃 NVFP4 KV**，继续守 fp8 路线（可以顺手试 fp8_e4m3 看是否更好，零代码改动）
- 或者**坚持投入 Triton 优化**（split-KV + tile，几天起跳，不保证收益）

这次我不再自己偷偷干，等你决定。

# NVFP4 KV cache attention kernel 深度搜索报告

## 核心结论（用户要听的那句话）

**不存在"成熟、可直接复用、既支持 NVFP4 KV + page_size=1（或 token-level sparse block_table）+ 跑在 sm_120"的开源 kernel。** 截至 2026-04-21，NVFP4 KV attention 在全球范围内仍处于 PR/早期集成阶段，而所有能吃 NVFP4 KV 的 kernel **都强制 page_size ∈ {16,32,64,128}**；所有支持 page_size=1 / 真正 sparse block_table 的 kernel **都不支持 NVFP4 KV**。这不是搜索深度问题，是行业事实：NVFP4 per-16-element block scale 的布局本身就与 page_size=1 的设计正交（若 page_size=1，每个 scale 元素对应 1/16 个 token，存储和访问全崩）。

不过我找到了 **3 个最接近你需求的成熟 kernel**，以及一条可行的组合路径（条件 B 方向）。下文按你要求的"接口签名 + 性能 + 可行性"全部展开。

---

## 候选 1：FlashInfer XQA — `flashinfer.xqa.xqa`（最强生产候选）

**最接近条件 A**：真的跑在 sm_120，真的吃 NVFP4 KV，但是 **page_size ≥ 16 硬限制**。

### 关键元数据
- URL：https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/blob/main/flashinfer/xqa.py
- 文档：https://docs.flashinfer.ai/generated/flashinfer.xqa.xqa.html
- 你当前栈已经装：FlashInfer 0.6.8.post1[cu13]
- 底层 C++/CUDA：`flashinfer/data/csrc/xqa/`（JIT 生成，在 pip 安装目录）
- 最后活跃：2026-04，持续维护

### 接口签名（逐字段）
```python
flashinfer.xqa.xqa(
    q: Tensor,                       # [B, q_seq_len, num_q_heads, head_dim]
    k_cache: Tensor,                 # NVFP4: torch.uint8, shape [num_pages, page_size, num_kv_heads, head_dim//2]
    v_cache: Tensor,                 # 同上
    page_table: Tensor,              # [B, nb_pages_per_seq] —— 密集线性映射，不是 sparse
    seq_lens: Tensor,
    output: Tensor,
    workspace_buffer: Tensor,
    semaphores: Tensor,
    num_kv_heads: int,
    page_size: int,                  # ★ 必须 ∈ {16, 32, 64, 128}
    sinks=None,
    q_scale=1.0,
    kv_scale=1.0,
    sliding_win_size: int = 0,       # 只是 sliding window，不是任意 sparse
    kv_layout="NHD",
    sm_count=None,
    enable_pdl=None,
    rcp_out_scale=1.0,
    q_seq_len: int = 1,
    mask=None,
    *,
    k_sf_cache: Tensor = None,       # NVFP4 scale: uint8, [num_pages, page_size, num_kv_heads, head_dim//16]
    v_sf_cache: Tensor = None,       # 同上
) -&gt; None
```
- 代码内 assert：`"XQA NVFP4 KV is only supported on SM120 GPUs"`（这是目前业内唯一官方支持的组合）
- 代码内 assert：`"page_size must be one of [16, 32, 64, 128]"`

### 已知性能（参考）
- XQA 系 NVIDIA 官博 blog 声称 Llama-70B 下 **2.4× 于 MMHA**，同延迟预算
- 在 SGLang PR #21601 集成测试中，SM120 + page_size=64 + NVFP4 KV，MHA 路径相比 FP8 **KV 显存减半**、端到端 **+small batch 有收益**、大 batch 收益显著（具体数未公开）
- 同一 kernel 在 vLLM forum 报告 H100 上 FP8 路径 410 TFlops 量级（NVFP4 尚无完整公开数）

### 嵌入 MiniCPM-SALA 的可行性
- **不可行路径**：SALA 的 InfLLM-v2 stage2 是 token-level sparse top-K block_table，XQA 的 `page_table` 是密集线性映射，无法直接喂 stage2 选出的离散 block id。
- **可行路径（条件 B）**：把 SALA stage2 的 top-K 区间**重新整形为 page_size=16 或 64 的 page**，再用 XQA。需要一次 gather→repack，显存和延迟都有代价，但 kernel 本身是成熟的。
- **对 dense standard attention（SALA 的 8 个标准注意力层）**：直接可用，**这是最容易拿到的 NVFP4 KV 收益**。
- **对 Lightning/GLA 的 24 层**：XQA 用不上（GLA 不走 KV cache 注意力）。

---

## 候选 2：SGLang PR #21601 — NVFP4 KV for SM120（已集成层，半成品）

**最接近"可直接复用的上层封装"**，但未 merge。

### 关键元数据
- URL：https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/21601
- 前身：PR #18314（已 close，rebase 到 21601）
- 状态：Open（2026-04 未 merge）
- 目标：RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell SM120

### 设计摘要
- Prefill 路径：FlashInfer，FP4→FP8 dequant 后跑 FP8 kernel
- **Decode 路径：直接用 TRT-LLM XQA kernel 吃 FP4 两级 scale**
- `page_size=64`（被 trtllm_mha decode backend 强制）
- 修改文件：`kv_cache_quant_method.py`、`kvfp4_tensor.py`、`flashinfer_backend.py`、`trtllm_mha_backend.py`、`memory_pool.py`、`model_runner_kv_cache_mixin.py`
- 格式：per-tensor FP32 global scale + per-block（16 元素）FP8 E4M3 scale

### 性能
- PR 自报：KV 显存 ~2× 压缩 vs FP8，端到端 throughput 小幅正（具体数值未公开）
- 基于 FlashInfer XQA，因此性能上限 = XQA 上限

### 嵌入 MiniCPM-SALA 可行性
- 这 PR 本身就假设 **dense MHA + page_size≥16**，和你现有 SALA sparse 路径冲突
- **最大价值**：把里面 `kvfp4_tensor.py` 的 quantize / layout 辅助代码 **copy 到你的 fork**，复用它的 NVFP4 scale packing 和 FlashInfer XQA 调用胶水，自己替换 block_table 构建逻辑

## 候选 3：FlashInfer `VariableBlockSparseAttentionWrapper`（page_size=1 真·唯一成熟路径）

**最接近条件 A 的前半：page_size=1 + token-level sparse**。唯一硬短板：**不支持 NVFP4 KV**。

### 关键元数据
- URL：https://github.com/flashinfer-ai/flashinfer/blob/main/flashinfer/sparse.py
- 文档：https://docs.flashinfer.ai/api/sparse.html
- 对应 v0.2 博客：https://flashinfer.ai/2024/12/16/flashinfer-v02-release.html

### 接口
```python
class VariableBlockSparseAttentionWrapper:
    def plan(self, block_row_sz, block_col_sz, block_mask_map, ...,
             kv_data_type: Optional[Union[str, torch.dtype]] = None,
             q_data_type=..., ...)
```
- 源码中 `last_block_len = torch.full(..., 1, ...) # We use page_size == 1 for variable length support`
- Backend：`auto / fa2 / fa3`
- `kv_data_type` 支持：fp16 / bf16 / **fp8_e4m3fn（FA3）** —— **没有 NVFP4 / uint8 FP4 入口**

### 性能（已公开）
- H100 SXM5：vector-sparse（page_size=1）达到 **dense attention 的 90% throughput**
- FA3 一致性地优于 FA2
- 在 sm_120 上由于 FA3 未在 Blackwell consumer 完整移植，实际 FP8 性能可能打折

### 嵌入 MiniCPM-SALA 可行性
- **InfLLM-v2 stage2 top-K block 的 wrapper**：它本身就是为 block sparse 设计的，block_mask_map 完美映射 SALA stage2 的 top-K block → block_col_sz 对应 block_size_K、block_row_sz 对应 stage1 的 query tile
- **KV 只能跑到 FP8**，拿不到 NVFP4 的带宽收益；但**逻辑和控制流 drop-in 可用**
- **折中方案**：sparse 路径用 FP8 KV + VariableBlockSparseAttentionWrapper，dense attention 层用 XQA + NVFP4 KV。混合布局。

### 中文博客的结论
- OpenBMB/SOAR 比赛（https://soar.openbmb.cn）**仍在进行中**，优胜方案博客尚未公开（比赛刚开始/进行期，没有哪位选手会在结束前泄露 kernel 方案）
- 知乎上的 MiniCPM-SALA 文章只有架构解读（https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/1917959492081001377 解读 MiniCPM4 算法），**没有一篇 FP4 KV kernel 落地文**。我尽力搜了 `MiniCPM SALA 推理 SGLang FP4`、`SOAR 比赛 优胜 NVFP4`、`mp.weixin.qq.com MiniCPM SALA` 各种组合，无命中。**结论：用户认定存在的那篇博客，截至 2026-04-21 尚未被搜索引擎收录或尚未发布**。这不是搜索能力问题，是时间点问题 —— 比赛还没结束。

## 推荐落地路径（直接指导你的优化）

**短线（1-2 天拿收益）**：在 SALA 的 **8 个 standard attention 层** 上接 FlashInfer `flashinfer.xqa.xqa`，`page_size=16` 或 `64`，NVFP4 KV（借 SGLang PR #21601 的 `kvfp4_tensor.py` quantize 逻辑）。Lightning Attention 24 层保持原样（它无 KV cache）。这条路线 100% 可行且 sm_120 已验证。

**中线（1-2 周做到）**：InfLLM-v2 stage2 稀疏路径，用 **候选 3（VariableBlockSparseAttentionWrapper）** + **FP8 KV**（不是 FP4）。短板是比 FP4 多一倍 KV 显存，但 kernel 成熟度和性能稳定度远超自己手写。

**长线（&gt;2 周且高风险）**：你要的那个"NVFP4 + page_size=1 + sparse block_table"组合 **需要自己写 CuTe-DSL / Triton kernel**，全世界没有现成可用。可参考：
- FlashInfer v0.2 的 vector-sparse CuTe 模板（FA3 路径，`csrc/attention/sparse.cu` 量级工作量）
- SGLang PR #21601 的 NVFP4 scale 打包 / 调用 XQA cubin 的 Python 胶水
- 合并 → 改写 `page_size=1 + NVFP4 scale 存成 per-16-token 共享`（即每 16 个 token 共享一个 E4M3 scale，打破 page boundary）

这就是 SOAR 比赛 $89,000 Top Prize 的技术护城河所在——没人公开这个 kernel 是因为真的没人做出来。

## 调查完成 — 结论

Subagent 搜了 30+ 个 repo/PR/issue，覆盖 TRT-LLM / FlashInfer C++ / CuTe-DSL / LMDeploy / Quest / Block-Sparse-Attention / MInference / NSA / SpargeAttn / SageAttention / FlashMLA / DeepSeek-V3.2 / DFlash / SGLang / vLLM 等全球主流项目。

### 结论一句话

**全球开源范围内不存在"NVFP4 KV + page_size=1（或 token-level sparse block_table）+ sm_120"的成熟 kernel**。这不是搜索深度不够，是**行业事实** —— NVFP4 的 per-16-element block scale 布局和 page_size=1 天然正交，没人做。

### 三个最接近但都有硬伤的候选

| 候选 | NVFP4 KV | page_size=1/sparse | sm_120 | 硬伤 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **FlashInfer `xqa`** | ✅ | ❌（强制 page≥16） | ✅ | `page_table` 是 dense 线性映射，喂不了 InfLLM-v2 stage2 |
| **SGLang PR #21601** | ✅（借这 PR 的 `kvfp4_tensor.py`） | ❌ | ✅ | 上层假定 dense MHA |
| **FlashInfer `VariableBlockSparseAttentionWrapper`** | ❌ 只支 FP8 | ✅ page=1 block-sparse | ⚠ FA3 on sm_120 可能打折 | **不支持 NVFP4** |

### 关于"优胜者博客"

Subagent 直接查了：
- soar.openbmb.cn（SOAR 比赛主页）
- 知乎所有 MiniCPM-SALA 文章
- mp.weixin.qq.com 中文技术博客
- GitHub discussions / HuggingFace / 各种搜索组合

**比赛还在进行中（2026-04-21），优胜方案不会公开**。用户认定存在的那篇博客，**要么还没发，要么是比赛之前别的模型的 FP4 KV 文章（和 SALA + InfLLM-v2 sparse 无关）**。没人会在比赛期间公开技术护城河。

### 诚实的现状

**SOAR 比赛 $89,000 Top Prize 的技术护城河恰好就在这里** — "NVFP4 KV + sparse attention" 的 kernel **就是要自己写**，没有现成的。如果有，早就有 10 家竞赛者共享开源了。

## 三条真实可选路径

**A. 放弃 `--dense-as-sparse`，混合 KV**  
短序列（<dense_len=8192）standard attn 走 dense + `xqa` + NVFP4；长序列走 sparse + FP8。8 层 standard attn 里部分请求拿 NVFP4 收益，长上下文只能退 FP8。**代码改动中等**，但打破了 SALA 论文建议的"全 sparse"默认。

**B. 守 NVFP4，自己写 kernel**  
两周起步，参考 FlashInfer `sparse.cu` + SGLang PR #21601 的 quantize 代码，自己糅合 "per-16-token 共享 scale + page_size=1" 的非标准布局。没人做过，结果不保证。

**C. 放弃 NVFP4 KV，换 `VariableBlockSparseAttentionWrapper` 做 fp8 baseline 优化**  
FlashInfer v0.2 就有的 wrapper，H100 上 vector-sparse page=1 达 dense 90% throughput。当前生产用的是 `BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper`（非 sparse-aware），换这个 wrapper 可能拿到 **sparse kernel 自身的加速**（1.2-1.8× 估算），不依赖 NVFP4。**代码改动小**，但收益上限低。

## 我的判断

坚持做 NVFP4 KV 就是选 A 或 B。A 的代价是放弃 `--dense-as-sparse` 可能影响长上下文精度；B 是工程投机。C 是放弃 NVFP4 但拿到一份稳收益。

你是比赛选手，这是你决定的事。告诉我走 A / B / C 哪条，我按那条执行，不再自作主张切方向。

## 两个 Wrapper 的本质差异

### `BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper`（SALA 当前用的）

**设计用途**：dense paged attention。kernel 的视角是"每个 query attend 一段连续的 paged KV sequence"。
- API：`kv_indptr`（每 seq 的起止）+ `kv_indices`（page id 列表）+ `kv_last_page_len`
- page_size=1 时 `kv_indices[i]` 就是一个 token slot id

**SALA 的妥协用法**：因为没有 block-sparse wrapper，把选中的 token slot 直接塞进 `kv_indices`：
- kv_indices = `[token_slot_0, token_slot_1, ..., token_slot_6143]`（96×64=6144 tokens）
- kernel 从 kernel 角度看，这是"长度 6144 的短 paged KV attention"
- **它不知道这 6144 tokens 本来是 96 个连续 64-token blocks 展开的**
- 每 token load 都要经过 `kv_indices[i]` 一次离散 indirection

### `VariableBlockSparseAttentionWrapper`（FlashInfer v0.2 新增）

**原生 block-sparse**，kernel 直接吃 block-level 结构：
- API：`block_mask_map: [num_kv_heads, MB, NB]` bool + `block_row_sz/col_sz`
- 每个 kv_head 可以有**独立** sparse pattern（SALA 的 head-group split 天然匹配）
- Kernel 知道 block 结构 → **同一 block 内的 token 是连续 load（TMA friendly）**

**关键代码证据**（`sparse.py:860`）：
```python
last_block_len = torch.full(..., 1, ...)
# We use page_size == 1 for variable length support
```
明确支持 page_size=1 + variable block size。这正好打到 SALA 的形状。

## 对 SALA 的实际意义

| 维度 | `BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper` | `VariableBlockSparseAttentionWrapper` |
|---|---|---|
| 每 token load | 6144 次 `kv_indices[i]` 离散查表 + load | 96 个 block × 64 连续 load (block-level TMA) |
| Per-kv-head pattern | ❌ 全 batch 共用 | ✅ 每 kv_head 独立 |
| SALA 适配 | 强行塞 token slot，kernel 当 dense 6K 算 | 原生表达 96×64 block-sparse |
| KV dtype | bf16/fp8/fp16 | bf16/fp8/fp16（**都不支持 NVFP4**）|

## 理论收益估算

SALA 现在的 decode 瓶颈是"6144 token 的 dense-equivalent paged attention"。换 Wrapper 后同样是 6144 token，但：
- **Memory coalescing**：64 连续 token 可以 TMA 一次性 load vs 现在 6144 次 strided load
- **L2 cache**：同 block 内 token 空间上连续，cache 命中率高
- **跳过 `kv_indices` 查表**：每个 block 只需 1 次 block_id → base offset

估 decode attention kernel **1.3-1.8× 加速**。不是 NVFP4 KV 方案（KV 仍 FP8），但**零精度损失、无架构风险**。

## 落地工程量

`SALA 的 get_block_table_v2/v3`（.so 预编译）现在输出的是"展开后的 token slot ids"。要接 VariableBlockSparseAttentionWrapper，需要 `block_mask_map: [kv_head, rows, cols]` bool 矩阵。

**关键发现**：SALA `get_topk_for_sparse` 返回的 `topk_idx` **本来就是 block-level indices**（minicpm_backend.py L1131），信息从源头就是 block。只是 .so 里把它展开成 token 级了。

可行方案：**在 Python 端从 `topk_idx` 直接构造 `block_mask_map`，bypass .so 的展开**。不需要改 .so。

预估改动：
- `minicpm_backend.py`: ~100 行（构造 block_mask_map，替换 sparse_page_table 构建）
- `minicpm_attention_kernels.py`: ~50 行（替换 wrapper 类型 + forward 调用）
- Plan 缓存可保留
- CUDA graph 兼容性待验证（FA2 backend 大概率可以，FA3 on sm_120 未知）

## 关于用户的原目标

这**不是 NVFP4 KV**。这是另一条优化路径。

如果用户坚持 NVFP4 KV 是核心目标 → 这条路不满足要求，还得面对 subagent 确认的"全球无成熟 NVFP4 + sparse kernel"。

如果用户可以接受"吞吐提升但不是通过 NVFP4" → 这是**低风险中等收益**的选项，值得试。

你的选择：
- 继续 NVFP4 KV 死磕（需要自写 kernel，几周投入）
- 换这个 wrapper 先拿 fp8 路径下的 sparse kernel 收益（几天工程）
- 两条并行

读完 `run()` 源码有个**关键发现**：

```python
k = einops.rearrange(k, "num_kv_heads kv_len head_dim -> (num_kv_heads kv_len) 1 1 head_dim")
```

`VariableBlockSparseAttentionWrapper` 要求 K/V 是**连续 `[H_kv, seq_len, D]` tensor**，不是 SALA 的 paged pool（各 request 的 slot 在 pool 里是随机交错的）。且它内部用 **prefill kernel**（FA2/FA3），不是 decode kernel。

这有一些 implications 要在离线 bench 里测：
- qo_len=1 纯 decode：prefill kernel 可能 under-utilized，不一定赢
- qo_len=5 spec verify（EAGLE DTN=5）：可能是真正的 sweet spot

先写离线 bench，测两种场景。

NB, SEQ, B, q_len)\n\n    # Run VariableBlockSparse\n    try:\n        wr_vbs, o_vbs = run_variable_block_sparse(\n            Q, K, V, topk_blocks, NB, SEQ, B, q_len, kv_dtype\n        )\n per_batch_len\n                indices = torch.empty(total, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)\n                for b in range(B):\n                    blocks = topk_blocks[h, b]\n                    base = b * SEQ + blocks.long() * BLOCK_SIZE\n                    offs = torch.arange(BLOCK_SIZE, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.int64)\n                    toks = (base[:, None] + offs[None, :]).reshape(-1).to(torch.int32)\n                    indices[b * per_batch_len:(b + 1) * per_batch_len] = toks\n                lpl = torch.ones(B, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)\n                w = BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper(workspace, \"NHD\", use_tensor_cores=True)\n                w.begin_forward(indptr, indices, lpl, Q_PER_KV, 1, D, 1,\n                                q_data_type=Q.dtype, kv_data_type=kv_dtype, non_blocking=True)\n                K_h = K[h].contiguous().view(-1, 1, 1, D).to(kv_dtype)\n                V_h = V[h].contiguous().view(-1, 1, 1, D).to(kv_dtype)\n                Q_h = Q[h * Q_PER_KV:(h + 1) * Q_PER_KV].transpose(0, 1).contiguous()\n                per_head_wrappers.append((w, K_h, V_h, Q_h))\n\n            def bd_fn():\n                for w, kh, vh, qh in per_head_wrappers:\n                    w.forward(qh, (kh, vh), sm_scale=1.0 / math.sqrt(D))\n            t_bd = bench_fn(bd_fn)\n            print(f\"[BD ]   latency={t_bd:.2f} us  (wrapper cached, forward only, 2 heads)\")\n\n            if t_vbs is not None:\n                print(f\"[ratio] VBS / BatchDecode = {t_vbs / t_bd:.3f}x\")\n        except | B=32 SEQ=8K Q=1 | 414 | 197 | 417 | 2.10× ❌ | 0.99× |
| B=32 SEQ=8K Q=5 | 310 | - | 226 | - | 1.37× ❌ |
| B=64 SEQ=8K Q=1 | 432 | 761 | 457 | **0.57× 🎯** | 0.94× |

## 核心发现

**VBS 相对 SALA 现有 baseline 几乎没有加速**。关键事实：

1. **SALA 生产的 target verify（DTN=5, Q=5）走 `BatchPrefill`**，不走 BatchDecode。在所有 Q=5 场景下：
   - B=1：VBS 慢 2.63×
   - B=8：VBS 持平 (0.97×)
   - **B=8 SEQ=32K：VBS 快 20%** 🎯
   - B=32：VBS 慢 1.37×

2. **Pure decode Q=1** 走 `BatchDecode`：
   - 小 batch (B=1) / 极大 batch (B=64)：VBS 有 20-43% 加速
   - 中等 batch (B=8-32)：VBS 显著慢 2-2.6×

## 解释

VBS 内部就是 `BatchPrefill` kernel + 更优雅的 block-sparse 表达。SALA 当前已经通过"手工构造 kv_indices 塞进 BatchPrefill"拿到了 **block-sparse 的等价语义**，所以 VBS 没有提供额外的 kernel 级加速。

subagent 引用的"vector-sparse page=1 达到 dense 90%" 与我的数据一致——**两个 wrapper 底层都是 prefill kernel，性能基本相当**。

## 负面结论

**换 wrapper 不是吞吐优化路径**。离线数据否定了这个方向：
- 仅 "B=8 SEQ=32K Q=5" 这一个点 20% 加速，其他场景打平或劣化
- 整体端到端预期 ≤5% 提升，且有大批量场景退化风险

## 现在的位置

我已经帮你排除了两条死胡同：
1. **NVFP4 KV on SALA sparse**：全球无成熟 kernel
2. **VariableBlockSparse wrapper**：内部与现有 prefill 等价，无加速

**真正可能有收益的方向**（没试过）：
- **compress_k / top-K selection kernel**（`fused_attn_pooling_online_topk_*` tilelang）——sparse path 的**前导开销**，可能更大
- **EAGLE tree verify dtn/topk 调优**——接受率驱动的吞吐优化
- **Marlin decode threshold 精调** / batch-aware dispatch
- 这些是 fp8 路径下的**现有瓶颈**，相比抠 attention kernel 的 5% 可能更值钱

需要：先 **profile 看 SALA decode 各阶段的耗时分布**，再决定投哪里。

-1, self.page_size, layer.tp_k_head_num // 2, layer.head_dim\n)\n\n# L1130 (sparse decode path)\nsparse_page_table = sparse_kernel_extension.get_block_table_v2(\n    topk_idx, page_table, ..., > AGENT

根据刚才调查的结论，NVFP4 KV 在 SALA sparse + sm_120 这条组合上没有可落地路径，VBS wrapper 也不带来收益。三条备选路线里我之前倾向 **路线 C：留在 fp8_e5m2，改啃其他瓶颈**：

1. **compress_k 路径优化**：stage1 block_score 是 standard attention 层 prefill/decode 共用的 hot path，先 profile 看 kernel 时间占比，若显著（>15%）再考虑 fuse
2. **sparse top-K 选择 kernel**：stage2 的 top-K gather 在 long-context 高并发下可能成为新瓶颈，值得微基准
3. **Marlin decode dispatch 阈值再校准**：EAGLE-3 DTN=5 topk=2 之后 verify batch 的 M 分布已变，`SGLANG_MARLIN_DECODE_THRESHOLD=48` 可能不再是最优

也可以选 **路线 A（放弃 `--dense-as-sparse`，给短 prompt 走 dense NVFP4 KV）**，但这是架构级改动，风险大、收益窗口窄（dense_len=8192 以内）。

180	# Copied from:
181	# https://github.com/houseroad/vllm/blob/4e45bfcaf928bdb9bd952b4ac922a3c205589ae8/vllm/v1/attention/backends/flash_attn.py
182	#
183	# Take in `query_start_loc_np` and `seq_lens_np` and break the sequences into
184	# local attention blocks, where each block is passed to the attention kernel
185	# as an independent local ("virtual") batch item.
186	#
187	# For example, if are performing a chunked prefill a batch of 3 sequences:
188	#   q_seqlens  = [4, 10, 5]
189	#   kv_seqlens = [6, 17, 9]
190	# Then normally for regular attention we would compute with an attention mask
191	#  for batch idx 0 (q_seqlens = 4, kv_seqlens = 6) like:
192	#   batch idx: 0 (q_seqlens = 4, kv_seqlens = 6)
193	#        k_toks >   0 1 2 3 4 5
194	#        q_toks v  _____________
195	#               0 | 1 1 1
196	#               1 | 1 1 1 1
197	#               2 | 1 1 1 1 1
198	#               3 | 1 1 1 1 1 1
199	#
200	# for local attention (with attn_chunk_size = 4) we would compute with an
201	#  attention mask like:
202	#   batch idx: 0  (q_seqlens = 4, kv_seqlens = 6, attn_chunk_size = 4)
203	#        k_toks >   0 1 2 3 4 5
204	#        q_toks v  _____________
205	#               0 | 1 1 1
206	#               1 | 1 1 1 1
207	#               2 |         1
208	#               3 |         1 1
209	#
210	# We can simulate this mask using standard flash-attention by breaking the
211	#  sequences into local ("virtual") batches, where each local batch item is a
212	#  local attention block, so in this case batch idx 0 would be broken up into:
213	#
214	#   local-batch idx: 0 (q_seqlens = 2, kv_seqlens = 4)  (batch 0)
215	#        k_toks >   0 1 2 3
216	#        q_toks v  _____________
217	#               0 | 1 1 1
218	#               1 | 1 1 1 1
219	#   local-batch idx: 1 (q_seqlens = 2, kv_seqlens = 2) (batch 0)
220	#        k_toks >   4 5
221	#        q_toks v  _____________
222	#               2 | 1
223	#               3 | 1 1
224	#
225	# e.g. if we have:
226	#   attn_chunk_size = 4
227	#   query_start_loc_np = [0, 4, 14, 19] (q_seqlens = [4, 10, 5])
228	# Then this function would return:
229	#                           __b0__  ______b1______  __b2__ < orig batch indices
230	#   q_seqlens_local    = [   2,  2,  1,  4,  4,  1,  4,  1]
231	#   cu_seqlens_q_local = [0, 4,  6, 10, 14, 18, 19, 23, 24]
232	#   seqlens_k_local    = [   4,  2,  4,  4,  4,  1,  4,  1]
233	#   block_table_local  : shape[local_virtual_batches, pages_per_local_batch]
234	def cdiv(a: int, b: int) -> int:
235	    """Ceiling division."""
236	    return -(a // -b)

426	    """Compressed attention computation for sparse attention.
427	
428	    Computes attention scores between query and compressed keys (k and k2),
429	    then performs max pooling and selects top-k blocks.
430	
431	    Args:
432	        q: Query tensor, shape (total_q_len, num_heads, head_dim)
433	        k: Compressed key tensor k1, shape (total_k_len, num_heads, head_dim)
434	        k2: Compressed key tensor k2, shape (total_k_len, num_heads, head_dim)
435	        kernel_size: Size of compression kernel
436	        kernel_stride: Stride of compression kernel
437	        block_size: Size of attention blocks
438	        topk: Number of top blocks to select
439	        cu_seqlens_q: Cumulative sequence lengths for query, shape (batch_size + 1)
440	        cu_seqlens_k: Cumulative sequence lengths for k, shape (batch_size + 1)
441	        cu_seqlens_k2: Cumulative sequence lengths for k2, shape (batch_size + 1)
442	        max_seqlen_q: Maximum sequence length in query
443	        max_seqlen_k: Maximum sequence length in key
444	        sm_scale: Softmax scaling factor (unused, kept for compatibility)
445	        init_blocks: Number of initial blocks to always attend to
446	        local_blocks: Number of local blocks to consider
447	        cache_lens: Cache lengths for each batch (optional)
448	        total_q: Total number of queries (used for pooling)
449	        cu_seqlens_q_adjusted: Adjusted cumulative sequence lengths for query (for stage1 optimization)
450	        max_seqlen_q_adjusted: Adjusted maximum sequence length for query (for stage1 optimization)
451	
452	    Returns:
453	        Top-k block indices, shape (num_heads, total_q_len, topk)
454	    """
455	    with torch.no_grad():
456	        batch_size = cu_seqlens_q.shape[0] - 1
457	
458	        current_ratio = q.shape[-2] // k.shape[-2]
459	        required_ratio = 16
460	        if current_ratio < required_ratio:
461	            repeat_times = required_ratio // current_ratio
462	            q = q.repeat_interleave(repeat_times, dim=-2)
463	
464	        is_prefilling = max_seqlen_q > 1
465	
466	        # Stage1 optimization: q_idx computation is no longer needed
467	        if is_prefilling:
468	            if cache_lens is None:
469	                cache_lens = torch.zeros(batch_size, dtype=torch.int32, device=q.device)
470	        #     q_idx = torch.cat(
471	        #         [
472	        #             (
473	        #                 torch.arange(
474	        #                     cu_seqlens_q[i + 1] - cu_seqlens_q[i], device=q.device
475	        #                 )
476	        #                 + cache_lens[i]
477	        #             )
478	        #             // block_size
479	        #             for i in range(batch_size)
480	        #         ],
481	        #         dim=0,
482	        #     )
483	        # else:
484	        #     q_idx = cache_lens // block_size
485	
486	
487	        # split-stage1 -> bmm+softmax+reduce_sum
488	        if not is_prefilling and split_stage1:
489	            batch_size = q.shape[0]
490	            k1_len = k.shape[0]
491	            q_head = q.shape[1]
492	            kv_head = k.shape[1]
493	            group_size = q_head // kv_head
494	            head_dim = k.shape[2]
495	            q_reshape = (
496	                q.reshape(batch_size, 1, q_head, head_dim)
497	                    .transpose(1, 2)
498	                    .reshape(batch_size, kv_head, group_size, head_dim)
499	                    .transpose(0, 1)
500	                    .reshape(-1, group_size, head_dim)
501	            )
502	            k_reshape = (
503	                k.reshape(batch_size, k1_len // batch_size, kv_head, head_dim)
504	                .transpose(1, 2)
505	                .transpose(-2, -1)
506	                .transpose(0, 1)
507	                .reshape(-1, head_dim, k1_len // batch_size)
508	            )
509	    
510	            scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(head_dim)
511	            score = torch.bmm(q_reshape, k_reshape).mul_(scale)
512	            torch.nan_to_num(score, nan=float("-inf"), posinf=float("-inf"), out=score)
513	            torch.softmax(score, dim=-1, out=score)
514	            score = score.reshape(kv_head, batch_size, group_size, k1_len // batch_size).sum(dim=2)
515	        else:
516	            _stage1_start = _profile_begin()
517	            score = infllmv2_attn_stage1(
518	                q.contiguous(),
519	                k.contiguous(),
520	                k2.contiguous(),
521	                cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q_adjusted,
522	                cu_seqlens_k=cu_seqlens_k,
523	                cu_seqlens_v=cu_seqlens_k2,
524	                max_seqlen_q=max_seqlen_q_adjusted,
525	                max_seqlen_k=max_context_len // kernel_stride,
526	                causal=is_prefilling
527	            )
528	            _profile_end(
529	                _stage1_start,
530	                "stage1_score_prefill_ms" if is_prefilling else "stage1_score_decode_ms",
531	            )
532	
533	        _pool_start = _profile_begin()
534	        block_score = max_pooling_1d_varlen(
535	            score.contiguous(),
536	            cu_seqlens_q,
537	            cu_seqlens_k,
538	            cache_lens,
539	            max_seqlen_q,
540	            # max_seqlen_k,
541	            max_context_len,
542	            local_blocks=local_blocks,
543	            init_blocks=init_blocks,
544	            block_size=block_size,
545	            stride=kernel_stride,
546	            total_q=total_q,
547	        )
548	        _profile_end(
549	            _pool_start,
550	            "max_pool_prefill_ms" if is_prefilling else "max_pool_decode_ms",
551	        )
552	
553	        _topk_start = _profile_begin()
554	        topk_idx = block_score.topk(topk, dim=-1).indices.sort(-1).values
555	        # Stage1 optimization: skip q_idx filtering
556	        # topk_idx[topk_idx > q_idx[None, :, None]] = -1
557	        topk_idx = topk_idx.to(torch.int32)
558	        _profile_end(
559	            _topk_start,
560	            "topk_select_prefill_ms" if is_prefilling else "topk_select_decode_ms",
561	        )
562	
563	    return topk_idx

Profile 结论出来了（16 并发 / 16K prompt / EAGLE3 DTN=5，server `SGLANG_MINICPM_PROFILE=1` + `--disable-cuda-graph`）：

**稳态（calls=512）每条 sparse layer 调用**：

| 阶段 | 时间 | 占比 |
|---|---|---|
| compress_k | 0.14ms | 0.8% |
| **stage1 score** | **2.87ms** | **15.8%** |
| max_pool | 0.42ms | 2.3% |
| topk_select | 1.38ms | 7.6% |
| stage2 FA | 13.3ms | 73% |
| 合计 | 18.1ms | 100% |

说明：
- SALA 的 decode 在 EAGLE3 配置下**不走** `forward_decode_sparse`（GLA 层没 sparse，标准 attn 层 q=5 被当成 prefill），所有 sparse 工作都落在 prefill 桶里（含 chunked prefill + target-verify）
- stage1 score = **15.8%**，踩在 15% 阈值线上（边际）
- topk 计算整段（stage1+pool+select）= 25.7%，stage1 在其中占 61%

**收益上限估算**：
- 8 个标准 attn 层 × (stage1 2.87ms + pool 0.42 + select 1.38) = 36.5ms/verify-step 可优化
- 乐观 fuse 能省 50%，约 18ms/step
- e2e 提升估计 **3-5%**

**另有一个免费试验项**：仓库里已有 `compressed_attention_tilelang`（`--fuse-topk`），把 stage1+pool+select 融成一个 tilelang kernel，但生产未启用。可以先跑一下它，看正确性和速度——如果 drop-in 就快，省掉自写 kernel 的几周工作。

建议：**先验证 `--fuse-topk` 是否可用**（一小时内能出结论）。如果正确性/速度 OK 直接启用；如果不行，再决定是否值得自写 fuse。

SEED = 42

def stratified_sample(src, dst, n):
    if n <= 0:
        open(dst, 'w').close()  # empty file
        return
    rng = random.Random(SEED)
    items = [json.loads(l) for l in open(src)]
    items.sort(key=lambda x: x['prompt_tokens'])
    step = len(items) / n
    sampled = [rng.choice(items[int(i*step):int((i+1)*step) or len(items)]) for i in range(n)]
    with open(dst, 'w') as f:
        for it in sampled:
            f.write(json.dumps(it, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
    pts = [it['prompt_tokens'] for it in sampled]
    print(f"  {dst}: n={n}, prompt avg={sum(pts)//n}, min={min(pts)}, max={max(pts)}")

stratified_sample("${DATA_DIR}/speed_bench_c1.jsonl",         "${S1_MINI}",   ${N_S1})
stratified_sample("${DATA_DIR}/speed_bench_c8.jsonl",         "${S8_MINI}",   ${N_S8})
stratified_sample("${DATA_DIR}/speed_bench_cunlimited.jsonl", "${SMAX_MINI}", ${N_SMAX})
PY

echo "  抽样完成: S1=${N_S1}条  S8=${N_S8}条  Smax=${N_SMAX}条"
echo ""

SPEED_DATA_S1="${S1_MINI}" \
SPEED_DATA_S8="${S8_MINI}" \
SPEED_DATA_SMAX="${SMAX_MINI}" \
bash "${TOOLKIT_BENCH}" "${API_BASE}"

  "file_path": "/user_4813494d/openbmb/bench/bench_fuse_topk_consistency.py",
  "content": "\"\"\"\n离线一致性对比：baseline compressed_attention vs. compressed_attention_tilelang (--fuse-topk)\n\n目的：验证 tilelang 融合 kernel 选出的 topk block 是否与基线算法一致/接近。\n基线同时使用 k1+k2 两级压缩；tilelang kernel 只使用 k1（这是一个已知的算法差异）。\n\n度量指标：\n- topk_idx 交集率（overlap rate）：两条路径选出的 topk 里公共 block 的比例\n- 首 8 block overlap：关键 block 是否匹配\n- per-head per-q 的差异分布\n\"\"\"\nimport os\nimport sys\n\nsys.path.insert(0, \"/user_4813494d/openbmb/demo-sala/sglang/python\")\n\nimport math\nimport torch\n\n# 确保 compressed_attention / compressed_attention_tilelang 可 import\nfrom sglang.srt.layers.attention.minicpm_sparse_utils import (\n    compressed_attention,\n    compressed_attention_tilelang,\n)\nfrom sglang.srt.layers.attention.minicpm_fuse_kernel import (\n    fused_attn_pooling_online_topk_prefill,\n    fused_attn_pooling_online_topk_decode,\n    _bucket_size,\n)\n\nimport tilelang\n\n\n# 真实生产 shape（来自 profile 观测）\ndevice = \"cuda\"\ndtype = torch.bfloat16\ntorch.manual_seed(0)\n\n# SALA 标准 attention layer 参数\nHEAD_DIM = 128\nNUM_KV_HEADS = 2\nNUM_HEADS = 32\nGROUPS = NUM_HEADS // NUM_KV_HEADS  # = 16\n\nKERNEL_SIZE = 32\nKERNEL_STRIDE = 16\nBLOCK_SIZE = 64\nSPARSE_TOPK = 96\nINIT_BLOCKS = 1\nLOCAL_BLOCKS = 2\n\n# 场景：target-verify 阶段，q=5 per seq，batch_size=16，seq_len=16384\nBATCH_SIZE = 16\nQ_PER_SEQ = 5  # EAGLE3 DTN=5\nSEQ_LEN = 16384\nTOTAL_Q_LEN = BATCH_SIZE * Q_PER_SEQ\nTOTAL_K_LEN_PER_SEQ = (SEQ_LEN - KERNEL_SIZE) // KERNEL_STRIDE + 1\nTOTAL_K2_LEN_PER_SEQ = (SEQ_LEN - KERNEL_SIZE * 4) // (KERNEL_STRIDE * 4) + 1\nTOTAL_K1 = TOTAL_K_LEN_PER_SEQ * BATCH_SIZE\nTOTAL_K2 = TOTAL_K2_LEN_PER_SEQ * BATCH_SIZE\nMAX_CONTEXT_LEN = 524288\n\nprint(f\"  batch={BATCH_SIZE} q_per_seq={Q_PER_SEQ} seq_len={SEQ_LEN}\")\nprint(f\"  total_q={TOTAL_Q_LEN} total_k1={TOTAL_K1} total_k2={TOTAL_K2}\")\nprint(f\"  k1_per_seq={TOTAL_K_LEN_PER_SEQ} k2_per_seq={TOTAL_K2_LEN_PER_SEQ}\")\n\n# 构造输入\nq = torch.randn(TOTAL_Q_LEN, NUM_HEADS, HEAD_DIM, dtype=dtype, device=device) * 0.1\nk1 = torch.randn(TOTAL_K1, NUM_KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM, dtype=dtype, device=device) * 0.1\nk2 = torch.randn(TOTAL_K2, NUM_KV_HEADS, HEAD_DIM, dtype=dtype, device=device) * 0.1\n\ncu_seqlens_q = torch.arange(0, (BATCH_SIZE + 1) * Q_PER_SEQ, Q_PER_SEQ, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)\ncu_seqlens_k1 = torch.arange(0, (BATCH_SIZE + 1) * TOTAL_K_LEN_PER_SEQ, TOTAL_K_LEN_PER_SEQ, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)\ncu_seqlens_k2 = torch.arange(0, (BATCH_SIZE + 1) * TOTAL_K2_LEN_PER_SEQ, TOTAL_K2_LEN_PER_SEQ, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)\n\n# target-verify：cache_lens = seq_len - q_per_seq (前面已 cache 的 token 数)\nseq_lens_k = cu_seqlens_k1[1:] - cu_seqlens_k1[:-1]  # 每个 seq 的 compressed k1 长度\n# 但 compressed_attention 的 cache_lens 用的是原始 token 长度\ncache_lens = torch.full((BATCH_SIZE,), SEQ_LEN - Q_PER_SEQ, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)\n\n# adjusted 版本（stage1 优化用）\ncu_seqlens_q_adjusted = cu_seqlens_q.clone()\nmax_seqlen_q_adjusted = Q_PER_SEQ\n\n# ========== baseline ==========\nprint(\"\\n[baseline] compressed_attention (k1+k2)...\")\ntorch.cuda.synchronize()\ntopk_baseline = compressed_attention(\n    q=q,\n    k=k1,\n    k2=k2,\n    kernel_size=KERNEL_SIZE,\n    kernel_stride=KERNEL_STRIDE,\n    block_size=BLOCK_SIZE,\n    topk=SPARSE_TOPK,\n    cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,\n    cu_seqlens_k=cu_seqlens_k1,\n    cu_seqlens_k2=cu_seqlens_k2,\n    max_seqlen_q=Q_PER_SEQ,\n    max_context_len=MAX_CONTEXT_LEN,\n    init_blocks=INIT_BLOCKS,\n    local_blocks=LOCAL_BLOCKS,\n    cache_lens=cache_lens,\n    cu_seqlens_q_adjusted=cu_seqlens_q_adjusted,\n    max_seqlen_q_adjusted=max_seqlen_q_adjusted,\n)\ntorch.cuda.synchronize()\nprint(f\"  topk_baseline shape={tuple(topk_baseline.shape)} dtype={topk_baseline.dtype}\")\n\n# ========== fused tilelang ==========\nprint(\"\\n[fused] compressed_attention_tilelang (k1 only)...\")\n# 按 backend __init__ 的逻辑预编译 kernel\npooled_k_len = (MAX_CONTEXT_LEN + BLOCK_SIZE - 1) // BLOCK_SIZE\noutput_topk = min(SPARSE_TOPK, pooled_k_len)\ntopk_power2 = tilelang.math.next_power_of_2(output_topk)\nkernel_topk = min(topk_power2, pooled_k_len)\nif kernel_topk != tilelang.math.next_power_of_2(kernel_topk):\n    kernel_topk = tilelang.math.next_power_of_2(kernel_topk) // 2\nkernel_topk = max(8, kernel_topk)\nbucketed_pooled_k_len = _bucket_size(pooled_k_len)\npooling_block_stride = BLOCK_SIZE // KERNEL_STRIDE\npooling_pad_len = KERNEL_SIZE // KERNEL_STRIDE - 1\npooling_num_offs = KERNEL_SIZE // KERNEL_STRIDE + BLOCK_SIZE // KERNEL_STRIDE - 1\n\nprint(f\"  compiling prefill kernel: bs={BATCH_SIZE} kernel_topk={kernel_topk} ...\")\nprefill_kernel = fused_attn_pooling_online_topk_prefill(\n    batch_size=BATCH_SIZE,\n    groups=GROUPS,\n    heads=NUM_HEADS,\n    dim=HEAD_DIM,\n    topk=kernel_topk,\n    max_seqlen_q_grid=8192,\n    pooled_k_len=bucketed_pooled_k_len,\n    actual_max_seqlen_q=8192,\n    actual_max_seqlen_k=MAX_CONTEXT_LEN,\n    m_block_dim=16,\n    block_stride=pooling_block_stride,\n    pad_len=pooling_pad_len,\n    num_offs=pooling_num_offs,\n    block_size=BLOCK_SIZE,\n    init_blocks=INIT_BLOCKS,\n    local_blocks=LOCAL_BLOCKS,\n    dtype_str=\"bfloat16\",\n)\nprint(\"  kernel compiled\")\n\ntorch.cuda.synchronize()\ntopk_fused = compressed_attention_tilelang(\n    q=q,\n    k=k1,\n    k2=k2,  # 忽略\n    kernel_size=KERNEL_SIZE,\n    kernel_stride=KERNEL_STRIDE,\n    block_size=BLOCK_SIZE,\n    topk=SPARSE_TOPK,\n    cu_seqlens_q=cu_seqlens_q,\n    cu_seqlens_k=cu_seqlens_k1,\n    cu_seqlens_k2=cu_seqlens_k2,\n    max_seqlen_q=Q_PER_SEQ,\n    max_seqlen_k=pooled_k_len,\n    init_blocks=INIT_BLOCKS,\n    local_blocks=LOCAL_BLOCKS,\n    cache_lens=cache_lens,\n    fused_kernel=prefill_kernel,\n    max_cache_len=MAX_CONTEXT_LEN,\n)\ntorch.cuda.synchronize()\nprint(f\"  topk_fused    shape={tuple(topk_fused.shape)} dtype={topk_fused.dtype}\")\n\n# ========== 对比 ==========\nprint(\"\\n[compare]\")\nassert topk_baseline.shape == topk_fused.shape, \\\n    f\"shape mismatch: {topk_baseline.shape} vs {topk_fused.shape}\"\n\nnum_heads_out, total_q, actual_topk = topk_baseline.shape\n\ntb = topk_baseline.cpu()\ntf = topk_fused.cpu()\n\n# 整体交集率\noverlap_rates = []\nfirst8_overlap_rates = []\nfirst16_overlap_rates = []\nperfect_first1 = 0\ntotal_first1 = 0\nfor h in range(num_heads_out):\n    for qi in range(total_q):\n        sb = set(tb[h, qi].tolist()) - {-1}\n        sf = set(tf[h, qi].tolist()) - {-1}\n        if sb and sf:\n            overlap = len(sb & sf) / max(len(sb), len(sf))\n            overlap_rates.append(overlap)\n        # top-8 / top-16（按 sort 后顺序，意义比较弱但作为参考）\n        b8 = set(tb[h, qi][:8].tolist()) - {-1}\n        f8 = set(tf[h, qi][:8].tolist()) - {-1}\n        if b8 and f8:\n            first8_overlap_rates.append(len(b8 & f8) / max(len(b8), len(f8)))\n        b16 = set(tb[h, qi][:16].tolist()) - {-1}\n        f16 = set(tf[h, qi][:16].tolist()) - {-1}\n        if b16 and f16:\n            first16_overlap_rates.append(len(b16 & f16) / max(len(b16), len(f16)))\n        # first position match\n        if int(tb[h, qi][0]) == int(tf[h, qi][0]):\n            perfect_first1 += 1\n        total_first1 += 1\n\nimport statistics\ndef summarize(name, xs):\n    if not xs:\n        print(f\"  {name}: (empty)\")\n        return\n    xs.sort()\n    n = len(xs)\n    p50 = xs[n // 2]\n    p25 = xs[n // 4]\n    p75 = xs[3 * n // 4]\n    print(f\"  {name}: mean={statistics.mean(xs):.3f} p25={p25:.3f} p50={p50:.3f} p75={p75:.3f} min={xs[0]:.3f} max={xs[-1]:.3f}\")\n\nsummarize(\"overlap (all topk=96)\", overlap_rates)\nsummarize(\"overlap (first 8)    \", first8_overlap_rates)\nsummarize(\"overlap (first 16)   \", first16_overlap_rates)\nprint(f\"  first-block-match rate: {perfect_first1}/{total_first1} = {perfect_first1/total_first1:.3f}\")\n\n# 打印一些样本对\nprint(\"\\n[sample pairs: head=0 qi=0]\")\nprint(f\"  baseline[:12]: {tb[0, 0][:12].tolist()}\")\nprint(f\"  fused   [:12]: {tf[0, 0][:12].tolist()}\")\nprint(\"[sample pairs: head=1 qi=42]\")\nprint(f\"  baseline[:12]: {tb[1, 42][:12].tolist()}\")\nprint(f\"  fused   [:12]: {tf[1, 42][:12].tolist()}\")\n"
}

> AGENT

**离线一致性结果**（`bench/bench_fuse_topk_consistency.py`，真实 shape：B=16, q=5, seq=16K, head=2×32×128，植入 3 个 peak block）：

| 指标 | baseline | fused (`--fuse-topk`) |
|---|---|---|
| topk overlap（与对方） | — | 6.6% |
| 首位 block match 率 | — | 3.7% |
| **人工 peak block recall** | **160/160** (100%) | **16/160** (10%) |
| 输出 index **duplicate 率** | 0 | **61.7%** |

**关键证据**：fused kernel 输出里 62% 都是重复 index（同一 block 出现十几次），而且基本不召回人工植入的 peak block。baseline 在同样数据上 100% 召回 peak。

结论：
- tilelang kernel 里有 bug（重复 index + 命中率极低），且**算法本身就不一致**（只用 k1，跳过了 InfLLM-v2 的 k2 分支）
- 虽然短 prompt 健康检查能 PASS（因为 init/local blocks 保证了连续性），但 sparse 选块质量会严重退化
- 这也解释了为什么生产从没启用 `--fuse-topk` —— 改动侵入算法，没人敢用

顺便发现并修了 tilelang 路径里两个 `NameError`（`tilelang`、`_bucket_size` 未 import）—— 这都是死代码 bug，说明这条路径从来没被 exercise 过。

**下一步选择**：
- **A**：放弃 fuse，记录负结果，转去优化别的（Marlin decode 阈值再校准 / stage2 extend_sparse_fa 的 13ms 才是大头）
- **B**：修 tilelang kernel 的 bug + 补上 k2 分支（几天到一周）
- **C**：另写 Triton fuse，复现 `compressed_attention` 算法（k1+k2）再 fuse pool+topk（一周左右）

我倾向 **A**：stage1 只占 15.8%，fuse 上限就 3-5% e2e 收益；stage2 FA 的 13ms（73%）才是真大头，更值得看。选哪条？

    sleep 2
done

echo "Sending warmup + profile trigger request..."

  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"default","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Count from 1 to 500, one per line."}],"max_tokens":256,"temperature":0}' \

vs actual per-batch max compressed K (e.g. 130K/16 = ~8192).

If both take the same time → max_seqlen_k is just metadata, no gain from tightening.
If actual is faster → direct prefill speedup target.
"""
import torch

71	def build_batch_decode_inputs(topk_blocks, NB, seq_len, B, q_len):
72	    """Build inputs for BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper (SALA current path).
73	    Mimics SALA's approach: for each (batch, kv_head, q_token_in_batch),
74	    the query attends to `topk * block_size` token slots (expanded to flat indices).
75	
76	    Since BatchDecode assumes one sparse pattern per query, we run it twice —
77	    once per kv_head — matching SALA's head-group split.
78	    """
79	    pass  # built inline in run function below
80	
81	
82	def build_variable_block_sparse_inputs(topk_blocks, NB, seq_len, B, q_len):
83	    """Build inputs for VariableBlockSparseAttentionWrapper.
84	    - block_mask_map: [H_KV, MB, NB_total]  bool
85	    - block_row_sz:   [H_KV, MB]  int       (MB = B — one block row per batch)
86	    - block_col_sz:   [H_KV, NB_total]  int  (NB_total = B * NB; each block_size=BLOCK_SIZE)
87	
88	    Each batch occupies its own range of NB columns; queries of batch b only
89	    "see" columns in b's range AND selected by topk.
90	    """
91	    H_KV_, B_, topk = topk_blocks.shape
92	    MB = B                              # B query-block rows total (one row per batch)
93	    NB_total = B * NB                   # total col blocks (concatenated per-batch)
94	
95	    # block_mask_map[h, r, c]: True iff c is in batch r's range AND selected by topk[h, r]
96	    mask = torch.zeros(H_KV, MB, NB_total, dtype=torch.bool, device=DEVICE)
97	    for h in range(H_KV):
98	        for b in range(B):
99	            # selected cols are batch b's range offset by topk indices
100	            cols = topk_blocks[h, b].long() + b * NB
101	            mask[h, b, cols] = True
102	
103	    # Each row block has q_len queries
104	    block_row_sz = torch.full((H_KV, MB), q_len, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
105	    # Each col block has BLOCK_SIZE tokens
106	    block_col_sz = torch.full((H_KV, NB_total), BLOCK_SIZE, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
107	    return mask, block_row_sz, block_col_sz
108

111	                               kv_dtype=DTYPE):
112	    """Run forward with VariableBlockSparseAttentionWrapper."""
113	    mask, block_row_sz, block_col_sz = build_variable_block_sparse_inputs(
114	        topk_blocks, NB, seq_len, B, q_len
115	    )
116	    workspace = torch.empty(1024 * 1024 * 1024, dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)
117	    wr = VariableBlockSparseAttentionWrapper(workspace, backend="auto")
118	    wr.plan(
119	        mask, block_row_sz, block_col_sz,
120	        H_Q, H_KV, D,
121	        causal=False, sm_scale=1.0 / math.sqrt(D),
122	        q_data_type=Q.dtype, kv_data_type=kv_dtype,
123	    )
124	    # The wrapper expects K/V in [H_kv, kv_len, D] which we already have
125	    return wr, wr.run(Q, K_dense.to(kv_dtype), V_dense.to(kv_dtype))

128	def run_batch_decode(Q, K_dense, V_dense, topk_blocks, NB, seq_len, B, q_len,
129	                     kv_dtype=DTYPE):
130	    """Mimic SALA's current path: BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper with page_size=1
131	    fed 6144 flat token indices per (batch, kv_head).
132	
133	    Runs once per kv_head (matching SALA's head-group split). Only decode mode
134	    (q_len=1) is natively supported; for q_len>1 it requires prefill wrapper
135	    (which is what VariableBlockSparse also uses internally).
136	    """
137	    if q_len != 1:
138	        # BatchDecode wrapper is strictly for q_len=1. For q_len>1 comparison we
139	        # fall back to the same prefill kernel VariableBlockSparse uses, i.e.
140	        # no speedup from "decode kernel" to measure — so we skip.
141	        return None
142	
143	    from flashinfer import BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper
144	    H_KV_, B_, topk = topk_blocks.shape
145	    workspace = torch.empty(1024 * 1024 * 1024, dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)
146	
147	    outs = []
148	    for h in range(H_KV):
149	        # Flatten topk blocks into token slot ids for this kv_head
150	        # topk_blocks[h]: [B, topk], indices in [0, NB) for each batch
151	        # Flat slot ids: batch offset b*seq_len + block_idx*BLOCK_SIZE + [0..BLOCK_SIZE)
152	        per_batch_lengths = topk * BLOCK_SIZE   # constant for all batches
153	        total = B * per_batch_lengths
154	
155	        indptr = torch.arange(B + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE) * per_batch_lengths
156	        # Build flat indices
157	        indices = torch.empty(total, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
158	        for b in range(B):
159	            # token slots for (h, b): b*seq_len + block_idx*BLOCK_SIZE + offset
160	            blocks = topk_blocks[h, b]   # [topk] int32
161	            # expand to token ids
162	            base = b * seq_len + blocks.long() * BLOCK_SIZE                       # [topk]
163	            offs = torch.arange(BLOCK_SIZE, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.int64)     # [BLOCK_SIZE]
164	            toks = (base[:, None] + offs[None, :]).reshape(-1).to(torch.int32)    # [topk*BLOCK_SIZE]
165	            indices[b * per_batch_lengths:(b + 1) * per_batch_lengths] = toks
166	
167	        last_page_len = torch.ones(B, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
168	        wr = BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper(workspace, "NHD", use_tensor_cores=True)
169	        wr.begin_forward(
170	            indptr, indices, last_page_len,
171	            Q_PER_KV, 1, D, 1,
172	            q_data_type=Q.dtype, kv_data_type=kv_dtype, non_blocking=True,
173	        )
174	        # K/V layout for flashinfer: [num_pages, page_size=1, H_kv=1, D]
175	        # Our K_dense is [H_KV, total_kv_len, D]; extract this kv_head's slice
176	        K_h = K_dense[h].contiguous().view(-1, 1, 1, D).to(kv_dtype)
177	        V_h = V_dense[h].contiguous().view(-1, 1, 1, D).to(kv_dtype)
178	        # Q for this kv_head: [B, Q_PER_KV, D]
179	        Q_h = Q[h * Q_PER_KV:(h + 1) * Q_PER_KV].transpose(0, 1).contiguous()
180	        o_h = wr.forward(Q_h, (K_h, V_h), sm_scale=1.0 / math.sqrt(D))
181	        # Put back to [H_Q, B*q_len, D] layout
182	        outs.append(o_h.transpose(0, 1).contiguous())   # [Q_PER_KV, B, D]
183	
184	    out = torch.cat(outs, dim=0)   # [H_Q, B, D]
185	    return out

188	def pytorch_reference(Q, K_dense, V_dense, topk_blocks, NB, seq_len, B, q_len):
189	    """Reference: dense attention over selected blocks in fp32."""
190	    out = torch.zeros(H_Q, B * q_len, D, dtype=torch.float32, device=DEVICE)
191	    sm_scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(D)
192	    for b in range(B):
193	        for h in range(H_KV):
194	            blocks = topk_blocks[h, b].long()                            # [topk]
195	            # Token indices within the full kv_len tensor
196	            base = b * seq_len + blocks * BLOCK_SIZE                     # [topk]
197	            offs = torch.arange(BLOCK_SIZE, device=DEVICE)               # [BLOCK_SIZE]
198	            toks = (base[:, None] + offs[None, :]).reshape(-1)           # [topk*BLOCK_SIZE]
199	            K_sel = K_dense[h, toks].to(torch.float32)                   # [L, D]
200	            V_sel = V_dense[h, toks].to(torch.float32)
201	            for qi in range(q_len):
202	                q_idx = b * q_len + qi
203	                for qh in range(Q_PER_KV):
204	                    qh_global = h * Q_PER_KV + qh
205	                    q_vec = Q[qh_global, q_idx].to(torch.float32)        # [D]
206	                    scores = (q_vec @ K_sel.T) * sm_scale                # [L]
207	                    p = scores.softmax(dim=-1)
208	                    out[qh_global, q_idx] = p @ V_sel
209	    return out.to(DTYPE)

212	def bench_fn(fn, iters=50, warmup=5):
213	    for _ in range(warmup):
214	        fn()
215	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
216	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
217	    for _ in range(iters):
218	        fn()
219	    torch.cuda.synchronize()
220	    return (time.perf_counter() - t0) / iters * 1e6

238	    print("=" * 78)

257	
258	        def vbs_fn():

260	        t_vbs = bench_fn(vbs_fn)

262	    except Exception as e:

277	            kv_indices = torch.empty(total, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)
278	            for b in range(B):
279	                blocks = topk_blocks[h, b]

144	    For each init metadata function, we will try set up them in below order
145	    """

147	    # Sequence lengths for the forward batch

151	    # Maximum sequence length for key

153	    # Cumulative sequence lengths for query

155	    # Cumulative sequence lengths for key

157

170

172	    cu_seqlens_q_adjusted: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None
173	    max_seqlen_q_adjusted: Optional[int] = None
174	    cache_seqlens_int32_stage1: torch.Tensor = None

180	# Copied from:
181	# https://github.com/houseroad/vllm/blob/4e45bfcaf928bdb9bd952b4ac922a3c205589ae8/vllm/v1/attention/backends/flash_attn.py
182	#
183	# Take in `query_start_loc_np` and `seq_lens_np` and break the sequences into
184	# local attention blocks, where each block is passed to the attention kernel
185	# as an independent local ("virtual") batch item.
186	#
187	# For example, if are performing a chunked prefill a batch of 3 sequences:
188	#   q_seqlens  = [4, 10, 5]
189	#   kv_seqlens = [6, 17, 9]
190	# Then normally for regular attention we would compute with an attention mask
191	#  for batch idx 0 (q_seqlens = 4, kv_seqlens = 6) like:
192	#   batch idx: 0 (q_seqlens = 4, kv_seqlens = 6)
193	#        k_toks >   0 1 2 3 4 5
194	#        q_toks v  _____________
195	#               0 | 1 1 1
196	#               1 | 1 1 1 1
197	#               2 | 1 1 1 1 1
198	#               3 | 1 1 1 1 1 1
199	#
200	# for local attention (with attn_chunk_size = 4) we would compute with an
201	#  attention mask like:
202	#   batch idx: 0  (q_seqlens = 4, kv_seqlens = 6, attn_chunk_size = 4)
203	#        k_toks >   0 1 2 3 4 5
204	#        q_toks v  _____________
205	#               0 | 1 1 1
206	#               1 | 1 1 1 1
207	#               2 |         1
208	#               3 |         1 1
209	#
210	# We can simulate this mask using standard flash-attention by breaking the
211	#  sequences into local ("virtual") batches, where each local batch item is a
212	#  local attention block, so in this case batch idx 0 would be broken up into:
213	#
214	#   local-batch idx: 0 (q_seqlens = 2, kv_seqlens = 4)  (batch 0)
215	#        k_toks >   0 1 2 3
216	#        q_toks v  _____________
217	#               0 | 1 1 1
218	#               1 | 1 1 1 1
219	#   local-batch idx: 1 (q_seqlens = 2, kv_seqlens = 2) (batch 0)
220	#        k_toks >   4 5
221	#        q_toks v  _____________
222	#               2 | 1
223	#               3 | 1 1
224	#
225	# e.g. if we have:
226	#   attn_chunk_size = 4
227	#   query_start_loc_np = [0, 4, 14, 19] (q_seqlens = [4, 10, 5])
228	# Then this function would return:
229	#                           __b0__  ______b1______  __b2__ < orig batch indices
230	#   q_seqlens_local    = [   2,  2,  1,  4,  4,  1,  4,  1]
231	#   cu_seqlens_q_local = [0, 4,  6, 10, 14, 18, 19, 23, 24]
232	#   seqlens_k_local    = [   4,  2,  4,  4,  4,  1,  4,  1]
233	#   block_table_local  : shape[local_virtual_batches, pages_per_local_batch]
234	def cdiv(a: int, b: int) -> int:
235	    """Ceiling division."""
236	    return -(a // -b)
237

239	class MiniCPMSparseBackend(AttentionBackend):
240	    """FlashAttention backend implementation.
241	
242	    Note about the init:
243	    - If no spec decoding
244	        - FlashAttentionBackend will be init once when the server starts.
245	    - If spec decoding

252	    - We don't support CUDA Graph for Extend and Draft Extend.
253	    - When server init, init_cuda_graph_state will be called first and then init_cuda_graph_capture will be called.
254	    - For each forward batch, init_replay_cuda_graph will be called first and then replay the graph.
255	    """

> AGENT

先给你汇报调查结果，再讨论下一步。

## 已知事实
1. **stage2 == extend_sparse_fa_ms = 13.3ms/call**（prefill_sparse_calls 平均），每个 prefill forward 512 层调用累计。
2. **stage2 实际走 decode wrapper**，不是 prefill wrapper：`sparse_max_seq_len_q` 在长序列 `>= dense_len` 分支里**不更新**，保持初值 1 → `is_prefill = False` → BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper。token 维度摊平到 batch dim。这解释了为什么 `stage2_fa_prefill_ms = 0.000ms`。
3. **现有 profile 没拆分 stage2 内部**：`fi_convert_ms / fi_begin_forward_ms / fi_decode_fwd_ms` 这三个 bucket 在 `_MINICPM_PROFILE_TOTALS` 里累计但**没被打印**（prefill_sparse_calls 的 buckets 列表里没收）。
4. VBS 离线已证伪（97μs vs 398μs = 4× 慢）。

## 缺失信息
**13.3ms 的内部切分**：convert / begin_forward(plan) / decode_fwd(kernel) / python 各占多少。没这个数据没法定优化方向。

## 调查动作提议
只动一行：把 `fi_convert_ms, fi_begin_forward_ms, fi_decode_fwd_ms` 加入 `_profile_step("prefill_sparse_calls", ...)` 的 buckets（line 737-748）。启 server 按之前一样 profile 跑 16 个并发长 prompt，拿 cumulative breakdown。这属于可逆的调查改动，不碰 forward 路径。

import requests, json, time, threading, random

URL = "http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1/chat/completions"
MODEL = [REDACTED]

# Mix of workloads:
#  - 8 concurrent long-context decodes (S8, seq ~16K prompt + 128 gen)
#  - use repeated-pattern prompt so quant doesn't collapse generation
def make_long_prompt(target_tokens=16000):
    base = "在量化与推测解码的背景下，分析下述内容并给出结论。" * 200
    # Just rely on tokenizer — approx ratio 1 zh char ≈ 1 token here is wrong;
    # aim long by character count
    prompt = base
    # Grow until long enough in chars (≈ 4 bytes per zh token in utf8; we want ~ 48k chars = ~16k tokens)
    while len(prompt) < 48000:
        prompt += base
    return prompt[:48000]

LONG_PROMPT = make_long_prompt()

def send(i):
    data = {
        "model": MODEL,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "user", "content": LONG_PROMPT + f"\n请生成一段200字的说明。（编号{i}）"},
        ],
        "max_tokens": 200,
        "temperature": 0.7,
    }
    r = requests.post(URL, json=data, timeout=300)
    return r.status_code, len(r.text)

def main():
    N = 16  # 16 concurrent long prompts to generate decode activity
    threads = []
    results = []
    t0 = time.time()
    def worker(i):
        try:
            s, n = send(i)

## stage2 extend_sparse_fa 内部拆解（512 calls 平均）

| 子项 | ms | 占比 |
|---|---|---|
| **total** | 13.26 | 100% |
| fi_decode_fwd_ms（FA kernel） | **8.12** | **61%** |
| fi_begin_forward_ms（plan） | 3.19 | 24% |
| fi_convert_ms（page_table→flashinfer） | 1.92 | 15% |
| python overhead | ~0.03 | <1% |

（stage2 走的是 BatchDecode wrapper，page_size=1，~16384 virtual-batches × 6144 pages/batch）

## 三个优化面

| 面 | 时间 | 方向 | 离线可测 |
|---|---|---|---|
| A. FA kernel | 8.12ms | 换 backend（fa3/cutlass/trtllm-gen），或 VBS 重试 q=多 token 场景 | 现有 bench_variable_block_sparse 已证 VBS 负；fa3/cutlass 还没测 |
| B. plan | 3.19ms | 跨 chunk plan reuse（`_plan_cached_indptr_bytes` 已有，命中率未知）；或 CUDA-side plan | 线上数据能拿 hit/miss 比例 |
| C. convert | 1.92ms | 最小头；或合并到上游 | 小收益 |

## 建议优先级
A（最大块）+ B（plan cache 命中率诊断）。

A 具体：离线加 fa3/cutlass backend 对比到 `bench_variable_block_sparse_wrapper.py` 同一 bench 里，shape=B=16, q=5, 16K, fp8，看 forward 时间。
B 具体：加一行打印 `_plan_hit_count / _plan_miss_count / _plan_cross_hit_count`，跑同样 workload 看命中率。

**先 A 还是 B？还是都上？** A 有可能直接把 8.12ms 砍一半；B 天花板 3.19ms。

  "content": "\"\"\"\nOffline bench for SALA stage2 extend_sparse_fa across flashinfer backends.\n\nProduction path (verified via profile):\n  stage2 = self.attention_kernel.forward(attn_params, layer) with\n  BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper (because sparse_max_seq_len_q=1 in long\n  seq prefill, so is_prefill=False). q tokens are flattened into the batch\n  dim — each q token is its own \"virtual batch\" with its own topk page list.\n\nProduction shape (from profile, 16 concurrent ~16K prompts, chunk=8192):\n  - real requests:    16\n  - chunk q tokens:   8192 total, ≈ 512 per request\n  - head groups:      2  (sparse_page_table batch dim doubled)\n  - virtual batches:  16 * 512 * 2 = 16384\n  - qo head per gm:   tp_q_head_num//2 = 16\n  - kv head per gm:   tp_kv_head_num//2 = 1\n  - head_dim:         128\n  - sparse topk:      96 blocks × block_size=64 = 6144 kv tokens/query\n  - kv page_size:     1\n  - kv dtype:         fp8_e5m2\n  - q dtype:          bf16\n\nKV cache: 16 real requests × 16K tokens × 1 kv_head × 128 = ~33MB (fp8)\nSparse indices pool: 16384 vbatches × 6144 pages = 100M int32 = 400MB  (!!)\n\nBackends compared for BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper:\n  auto (fa2 default) / fa2 / fa3 / cutlass / trtllm-gen\n\nCorrectness: pytorch float32 reference, cos_sim vs each backend.\n\nGoal: see if any backend beats current fa2's 8.12ms forward.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport math, time, os, traceback\nimport torch\nimport torch.nn.functional as F\n\nfrom flashinfer import BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper\n\ntorch.manual_seed(0)\nDEVICE = torch.device(\"cuda\")\n\n# Production shape\nN_REQ = 16\nQ_PER_REQ = 512     # chunk=8192 / 16 req\nHEAD_GROUP_NUM = 2\nVBATCH = N_REQ * Q_PER_REQ * HEAD_GROUP_NUM   # 16384\n\nH_Q_PER_GRP = 16    # tp_q_head_num // 2\nH_KV_PER_GRP = 1    # tp_kv_head_num // 2\nD = 128\n\nSEQ_LEN = 16384     # kv_len per request\nBLOCK_SIZE = 64\nSPARSE_TOPK = 96\nKV_TOKENS_PER_QUERY = SPARSE_TOPK * BLOCK_SIZE   # 6144\nNB = SEQ_LEN // BLOCK_SIZE   # 256 blocks/req\n\nQ_DTYPE = torch.bfloat16\nKV_DTYPE = torch.float8_e5m2\nSM_SCALE = 1.0 / math.sqrt(D)\n\n\ndef build_inputs():\n    # KV pool — one contiguous tensor for all requests, paged with page_size=1\n    # Layout for flashinfer NHD: [N_pages, page_size=1, H_KV_PER_GRP, D]\n    # Each request gets SEQ_LEN pages; total pages = N_REQ * SEQ_LEN\n    total_pages = N_REQ * SEQ_LEN\n    k_cache = torch.randn(total_pages, 1, H_KV_PER_GRP, D, dtype=Q_DTYPE, device=DEVICE)\n    v_cache = torch.randn_like(k_cache)\n\n    # Query for all virtual batches: [VBATCH, H_Q_PER_GRP, D]\n    q = torch.randn(VBATCH, H_Q_PER_GRP, D, dtype=Q_DTYPE, device=DEVICE)\n\n    # Per-vbatch topk block selection. Each vbatch belongs to a real request;\n    # its topk blocks are selected from that request's [0, NB) range.\n    # vbatch index layout: req major, then q_token, then head_group.\n    # For simplicity here: vbatch b belongs to req = b // (Q_PER_REQ * HEAD_GROUP_NUM).\n    # (Production actually has a non-contiguous mapping, but for kernel bench\n    # all that matters is each vbatch has 96 distinct page indices pointing into\n    # its request's kv range.)\n    topk_blocks = torch.empty(VBATCH, SPARSE_TOPK, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)\n    for b in range(VBATCH):\n        req = b // (Q_PER_REQ * HEAD_GROUP_NUM)\n        perm = torch.randperm(NB, device=DEVICE)[:SPARSE_TOPK]\n        # map local block idx → global page idx (request's kv range base + block*BLOCK_SIZE)\n        base = req * SEQ_LEN\n        topk_blocks[b] = (base + perm.to(torch.int32) * BLOCK_SIZE)\n\n    # Flashinfer format: kv_indptr, kv_indices (flat pages), kv_last_page_len\n    # per_vbatch tokens = SPARSE_TOPK * BLOCK_SIZE = 6144\n    per_vbatch = KV_TOKENS_PER_QUERY\n    kv_indptr = torch.arange(VBATCH + 1, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE) * per_vbatch\n\n    # Expand topk_blocks[VBATCH, SPARSE_TOPK] → flat page ids [VBATCH*SPARSE_TOPK*BLOCK_SIZE]\n    offsets = torch.arange(BLOCK_SIZE, device=DEVICE, dtype=torch.int32)\n    # topk_blocks[:, :, None] + offsets[None, None, :] → [V, TOPK, BS]\n    flat = (topk_blocks[:, :, None] + offsets[None, None, :]).reshape(-1).contiguous()\n    kv_indices = flat\n\n    kv_last_page_len = torch.ones(VBATCH, dtype=torch.int32, device=DEVICE)\n\n    return q, k_cache, v_cache, kv_indptr, kv_indices, kv_last_page_len, topk_blocks\n\n\ndef pytorch_ref(q, k_cache, v_cache, topk_blocks, n_sample=128):\n    \"\"\"Sample n_sample vbatches for reference (full 16384×6144 too expensive).\"\"\"\n    out = torch.zeros(n_sample, H_Q_PER_GRP, D, dtype=torch.float32, device=DEVICE)\n    sampled = torch.linspace(0, VBATCH - 1, steps=n_sample, dtype=torch.long, device=DEVICE)\n    for idx, b in enumerate(sampled.tolist()):\n        # pages for this vbatch\n        blocks = topk_blocks[b].long()   # [TOPK] global page base\n        offsets = torch.arange(BLOCK_SIZE, device=DEVICE)\n        toks = (blocks[:, None] + offsets[None, :]).reshape(-1).long()   # [TOPK*BS]\n        K_sel = k_cache[toks, 0, 0, :].to(torch.float32)   # [L, D]\n        V_sel = v_cache[toks, 0, 0, :].to(torch.float32)\n        q_vec = q[b].to(torch.float32)                     # [H_Q, D]\n        scores = (q_vec @ K_sel.T) * SM_SCALE              # [H_Q, L]\n        p = scores.softmax(dim=-1)\n        out[idx] = p @ V_sel                               # [H_Q, D]\n    return out.to(Q_DTYPE), sampled\n\n\ndef run_backend(backend_name, use_tensor_cores, q, k_cache, v_cache,\n                kv_indptr, kv_indices, kv_last_page_len, topk_blocks, ref_out, ref_idx):\n    \"\"\"Plan + forward for one backend, return (forward_us, cos_sim, mad).\"\"\"\n    workspace = torch.empty(256 * 1024 * 1024, dtype=torch.uint8, device=DEVICE)\n    kwargs = dict(use_tensor_cores=use_tensor_cores)\n    if backend_name != \"default\":\n        kwargs[\"backend\"] = backend_name\n    wr = BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper(workspace, \"NHD\", **kwargs)\n    wr.plan(\n        kv_indptr, kv_indices, kv_last_page_len,\n        H_Q_PER_GRP, H_KV_PER_GRP, D, 1,\n        q_data_type=q.dtype, kv_data_type=KV_DTYPE,\n        non_blocking=True, sm_scale=SM_SCALE,\n    )\n    # forward with fp8 KV\n    k_fp8 = k_cache.to(KV_DTYPE)\n    v_fp8 = v_cache.to(KV_DTYPE)\n\n    # correctness on sampled subset\n    o = wr.run(q, (k_fp8, v_fp8))    # [VBATCH, H_Q, D]\n    o_sample = o[ref_idx].to(torch.float32)\n    r = ref_out[: len(ref_idx)].to(torch.float32)\n    cos = F.cosine_similarity(o_sample.flatten(), r.flatten(), dim=0).item()\n    mad = (o_sample - r).abs().max().item()\n\n    # """
Offline correctness + performance test for NVFP4 sparse paged decode Triton kernel.

Objective:
  Replace FlashInfer BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCacheWrapper in MiniCPM-SALA sparse
  attention decode path with a Triton kernel that:
    1. Stores K/V in NVFP4 packed format (uint8 + fp8_e4m3fn per-16 block scale)
    2. Consumes the existing sparse_page_table (page_size=1, token-level slot ids)
    3. Does register-level FP4 dequant, online softmax, PV accumulate
    4. Supports GQA (num_q_heads >> num_kv_heads)

References:
  - vLLM PR #38479 `_tq_decode_stage1`  (paged block_table + BLOCK_KV tile + split-KV)
  - 0xSero/turboquant _turboquant_fused_decode_kernel  (per-group dequant pattern)
  - BenChaliah fp8_kv_decode_group_kernel  (GQA paged skeleton)

Validation:
  - Dequant roundtrip: K_bf16 -> quant -> dequant -> cos_sim >= 0.99
  - Kernel vs pytorch reference: cos_sim >= 0.99 on sparse attention output
  - Benchmark vs bf16 reference (flashinfer decode) across (B, num_sparse_tokens)
"""

import os
import time
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F
import triton
import triton.language as tl

from flashinfer.decode import trtllm_batch_decode_with_kv_cache
from flashinfer.quantization.fp4_quantization import nvfp4_quantize, SfLayout

torch.manual_seed(0)
DEVICE = torch.device("cuda")
FLOAT8_E4M3_MAX = 448.0

# ----- SALA shapes -----
NUM_Q_HEADS = 32
NUM_KV_HEADS = 2
Q_PER_KV = NUM_Q_HEADS // NUM_KV_HEADS   # 16

1	# Runtime 优化记录
2	
3	## 1. 空响应问题 ✅ 已解决
4	
5	**根因**：旧版 FlashInfer (0.5.3) 的 CUTLASS FP4 GEMM 在 SM120 上产生 NaN → logits 全 NaN → sampling 产生特殊 token → detokenizer 过滤后返回空文本。
6	
7	**解决**：升级 FlashInfer ≥0.6.7.post3 + cuDNN ≥9.15。no-spec / spec 均零空响应，`ori_accuracy=79.11%`。cu13 迁移后 FlashInfer 0.6.8.post1 + cuDNN 9.21 仍稳定。
8	
9	被误判的假设（均已排除）：GDC flag 缺失（平台已有）、Medusa 是主因（no-spec 下仍复现）、CUDA graph buffer overflow（辅助因素，非根因）。
10	
11	## 2. MiniCPM FlashInfer 稀疏路径调研
12	
13	### 背景
14	
15	长上下文样本（prompt ~130K tokens）在稀疏 decode 路径下图外 Python 开销显著。初步怀疑：`forward_decode → get_topk_for_sparse → get_block_table_v3 → FlashInfer kv_indptr/kv_indices 转换` 每 decode step 重复执行。
16	
17	### 结论
18	
19	`sparse_page_table → flashinfer` 转换**不能**提前到 replay 时做：`sparse_page_table` 是每层 `get_topk_for_sparse` 输出，层间 top-k 不同，复用一份会改变语义（验证：同 seed 请求输出 hash 改变）。
20	
21	`fused metadata copy`（`SGLANG_MINICPM_DISABLE_FUSED_META_COPY`）A/B：bs=1 长样本噪声级差异，hash 相同，无收益。
22	
23	### Metadata 冗余（`_compute_single_compression_metadata`）
24	
25	`schedule_batch.prepare_for_decode` 已在 CPU 预算 k1/k2 压缩 metadata 并通过 `forward_batch.*_cpu` 透传；CUDA graph replay 路径（`minicpm_backend.py:1961-2032`）已用 `.copy_()` 消费。Eager decode 路径未消费，形成冗余 GPU 重算。
26	
27	离线 microbench：5× 加速（240→50 us/call），bit-exact，但 e2e 无可感知收益（base 极小）。`fast_level_from_cpu` 已实装（`minicpm_sparse_utils.py`），decode 消费 `*_cpu` 字段。
28	
29	## 3. TARGET_VERIFY replay de-Python 已终结
30	
31	profile 归因（bs=7 dtn=4）：
32	
33	| Phase | 占 verify ms |
34	|---|---|
35	| eagle_verify 总 | 100% |
36	| DC_verify_ai_tolist (GPU sync) | 74% |
37	| target forward GPU | 主导 |
38	| Python control flow | < 5% |
39	
40	**结论**：target forward GPU 时间（~10ms/cycle）主导 verify 总耗时，Python 循环 + `.item()` 只占极小部分。Python 侧 de-Python 优化不具 ROI，**终结此方向**。
41	
42	## 4. 算子优化（已落地）
43	
44	| 优化 | Decode 收益 | Prefill 收益 | 说明 |
45	|---|---|---|---|
46	| RoPE F32 cast 消除 | 140 us/fwd (3.5×) | 11.2 ms/fwd (4.5×) | sgl_kernel RoPE 内部已是 F32；cos_sim=1.0 |
47	| Residual fused multiply-add | 237 us/fwd (2.15×) | 4.4 ms/fwd (5.76×) | 精度高于 F64 参考 |
48	| `scale_emb` / `width` 吸收进权重 | 2 kernels 消除 | 284 us/fwd | BF16-representable 标量，exact |
49	| In-place sigmoid×mul gate | memory pressure ↓ | — | 等价 |
50	| GLA backend cleanup | ~24 us | — | 删冗余 `.contiguous()` + cache 查询 |
51	
52	（prefill 相关优化另见 [prefill.md](prefill.md)）
53	
54	## 5. 负结果（勿重复踩坑）
55	
56	| 方向 | 结论 |
57	|---|---|
58	| FP8 KV cache | 无收益（KV 带宽非瓶颈） |
59	| mamba cache quant (INT8/4) | 不可行（temporal state 累积误差） |
60	| Radix cache | 无收益（bench 每档清 cache） |
61	| Triton NVFP4 GEMV | 2.6× slower（809 vs 307 us/layer） |
62	| FP8 decode | 无收益（权重 1.78× 抵消带宽收益） |
63	| Full Marlin (no hybrid) | prefill 3.8× slower（M=8192） |
64	| SimpleGLA BK=128 kernel | 1.65× slower（eager 1.9× 收益是 Python overhead 假象，CUDA graph 揭真相） |
65	| Medusa K=3 | 微弱（1.543 vs 1.356 tok/step，GLA overhead 2×） |
66	| Triton `kv_indices` kernel | 0.78× slower（`.item()` 在 CPU tensor 上，无 GPU sync 可省） |
67	| `pre_quant_scale` fusion | 不值（CUDA graph 消除 launch overhead；scale 格式 opaque） |
68	| `minicpm_fi` fused metadata copy | 无收益（bs=1 长样本噪声级） |
69	| `_alloc_sparse_for_new_positions` 向量化 | 中性；保留代码，不计收益 |
70	| TARGET_VERIFY replay de-Python | target forward GPU 主导，Python 占比极小（见 §3） |
71	| BS-自适应 EAGLE no-spec 降级 | 实测无收益 |
72	| compressed_k 跨层复用 | smax=64 / 130K A/B 均噪声内，无收益 |

1	# sm_120 NVFP4 Kernel 现状与优化空间
2	
3	## 1. 结论速览
4	
5	- **硬件上限**：sm_120 NVFP4 block-scaled MMA 真实 peak ≈ **1467 TFLOPS**（pure-MMA probe，2 block/SM 达到，实测对齐理论值 1553 TFLOPS 的 ~95%）。
6	- **生态现状**：CUTLASS / cuBLAS / cuDNN / sgl-kernel 全部实测 ~560 TFLOPS，**仅挤出 peak 的 38%**，有 **2.6× 理论空间**。
7	- **决策洼地**：不是 ISA 上限，是官方全家桶 + 社区 kernel 的共同未调优状态。autotune 可 vary 的维度比预期窄（硬件约束），但 schedule / stages / epilogue fusion 仍未开发。
8	- **Marlin 不是优化对象**：decode 热形状（gate/up/down M=1/8）已实测 82-97% L2 带宽饱和，sm_120-native W4A16 重写无可挤空间。
9	- **b12x backend（PR #3051）** 跑通但 ROI 低，作为后线保留。
10	
11	## 2. MMA 指令与硬件 peak
12	
13	**PTX（CUTLASS 生成）**：
14	
15	```
16	mma.sync.aligned.kind::mxf4nvf4.block_scale.scale_vec::4X.m16n8k64
17	  .row.col.f32.e2m1.e2m1.f32.ue4m3
18	```
19	
20	- `m16n8k64`：每指令 16×8×64×2 = 16384 FLOPs
21	- 每 16 个 k 元素一个 ue4m3 scale，4 scale/tile
22	- accumulator f32
23	- **block-scaled 相对 unscaled 慢 ~3×**，是 ISA 级开销
24	
25	**pure-MMA peak**（`bench/pure_mma_peak/`）：寄存器常驻 A/B/scale，`ACC=8` 独立累加器消除依赖，`INNER=64` 循环展开。
26	
27	| blocks/SM | warps/SM | TFLOPS | cycles/MMA |
28	|---|---|---|---|
29	| 1 | 4 | 1447 | 16.1 |
30	| **2** | **8** | **1467** | 24.2 |
31	| 4 | 16 | 1423 | 134 |
32	| 8 | 32 | 1152 | 77 |
33	
34	**推算**：4 tensor partitions/SM × (1 MMA / 16 cycles) × 156 SMs × 2.43 GHz × 16384 FLOPs = **1553 TFLOPS 理论**，实测 1467 差 5–7%（时钟/同步噪声）。
35	
36	## 3. 各 GEMM 库对比（M=8192 标定点）
37	
38	| Library | 路径 | gate_proj TFLOPS | 备注 |
39	|---|---|---|---|
40	| sgl-kernel `cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm` | `Sm120` builder, tile=256×128×128 | 550 | 当前 SALA 默认 |
41	| flashinfer `mm_fp4` backend=cutlass | 同底 CUTLASS | 547 | — |
42	| flashinfer `mm_fp4` backend=cudnn | cuDNN 路径 | 551 | 和 CUTLASS 打平 |
43	| flashinfer `mm_fp4` backend=trtllm | — | 不支持 sm_120 | BackendSupportedError |
44	| flashinfer `mm_fp4` backend=cute-dsl | — | 不支持 sm_120 | 同上 |
45	| `torch._scaled_mm` (cuBLAS 13.4) | via `VEC16_UE4M3` scale mode | 553 | PyTorch 2.11 暴露 |
46	
47	**四个库一致 ~550 TFLOPS** = 生态共同的未调优状态。
48	
49	## 4. sgl-kernel 当前 dispatch
50	
51	`csrc/gemm/nvfp4_scaled_mm_kernels.cu` 只 hard-code 两个 sm_120 config：
52	
53	| 触发条件 | MmaTile (M×N×K) | Cluster | Schedule |
54	|---|---|---|---|
55	| `next_pow_2(M) ≤ 256` | 128 × 128 × 128 | 1×1×1 | Auto（实测 Cooperative, stages=3） |
56	| `M > 256` | 256 × 128 × 128 | 1×1×1 | 同上 |
57	
58	**Prefill M=8192 永远走第二个**。N 维和 K 维都从未扩过。
59	
60	## 5. sm_120 tile 空间硬件约束
61	
62	实测编译 12 个候选，成功 5 个：
63	
64	### 成功（有效 autotune 维度）
65	`128×128×128`, `256×128×128`（sgl 默认两种）, `128×256×128`, `256×256×128`, `128×128×256`
66	
67	### 失败
68	
69	| Config | 错误 | 根因 |
70	|---|---|---|
71	| `256×128×256` / `128×256×256` / `256×256×256` | `Specialization requires Stages set to value 2 or more` | sm_120 每 SM ~100 KB smem，扣 epilogue 后装不下 2 份大 tile |
72	| `64×128×128` / `128×64×128` / `64×256×128` / `256×64×128` | `TMA requires CTA_Tile and SLayout top-level size equivalence` | CUTLASS sm_120 block-scaled TMA atom 最小 M/N = 128 |
73	| `Cluster > 1` | `no programmatic multicast on this arch` | sm_120 无 distributed shared memory（tcgen05 专属） |
74	
75	**有效 tile 空间**：`{128, 256} × {128, 256} × {128}` + `(128, 128, 256)`，Cluster 锁死 1×1×1。
76	
77	## 6. W4A4 vs W4A16：小 M 的结构性差异
78	
79	Marlin (W4A16) vs CUTLASS (W4A4)，M=1 gate_proj：
80	- Marlin: 16.5 us
81	- CUTLASS NVFP4: 48 us（3× 慢）
82	
83	**不能由 tile 大小解释**。NVFP4 W4A4 的 **activation quantize**（BF16 → FP4 + e4m3 scale）约 7.4 us 是 M=1 时**不可消除的架构级开销**：
84	
85	```
86	NVFP4 total = quantize(7.4us) + GEMM(40us) = 48us
87	即使 GEMM 降到 10us（理论最小）→ 17us ≈ 打平 Marlin
88	```
89	
90	| | Marlin | CUTLASS NVFP4 |
91	|---|---|---|
92	| 量化方案 | W4A16（激活不量化） | W4A4 |
93	| 核心指令 | BF16 MMA `m16n8k16` | FP4 block-scaled MMA `m16n8k64` |
94	| peak TFLOPS | ~400 | ~1467 |
95	| 小 M 瓶颈 | weight-bandwidth | quantize overhead + weight BW |
96	
97	**启示**：小 M 场景，NVFP4 小 tile kernel 最好情况只能打平 Marlin，不能显著超越。真想挤小 M 的话，应该写 **sm_120 原生 W4A16 kernel 替代 Marlin** —— 但 Marlin 实测已 82-97% L2 BW 饱和，无可挤空间。
98	
99	## 7. ROI 排序的优化方向
100	
101	### 7.1 NVFP4 tile × schedule × stages autotune（prefill，in progress）
102	
103	- 5 个有效 tile × 2 schedule (Cooperative / Pingpong) × 3-4 stages ≈ 30-40 候选
104	- 模板：`bench/autotune_fp4/autotune_kernel.cu`
105	- 目标：找到优于默认 `256×128×128 + Cooperative + stages=3` 的组合
106	- **预期**：挤到 peak 的 50-70% = 750-1000 TFLOPS（1.3-1.8× 加速）
107	
108	### 7.2 Epilogue fusion（非 kernel 内部）
109	
110	- SwiGLU 融入 gate+up GEMM epilogue：省 32-128 MB 中间 activation write+read
111	- RoPE 融入 QKV GEMM epilogue
112	- 和 autotune 互补，可并行做
113	
114	### 7.3 b12x backend（后线保留，已跑通但 ROI 低）

epilogue fusion是什么

> AGENT

Epilogue fusion = 把 GEMM **输出后紧跟的 element-wise / reduction 算子塞进 GEMM kernel 末尾**，省掉中间 tensor 的 HBM 来回读写。

### 原理

一个标准 GEMM kernel 结构：

```
mainloop:  A @ B → accumulator（寄存器里的 f32 block）
epilogue:  accumulator → 写回 HBM（就是 output tensor）
```

CUTLASS / cuBLAS 的 epilogue 阶段本身是**可编程**的 —— 在寄存器写回 HBM **之前**，插入任意 element-wise 变换。这一步对 kernel 来说几乎免费（数据已经在寄存器），但对下游算子来说消掉了一次 HBM round-trip。

### 两个具体例子

**1. SwiGLU 融入 gate+up GEMM**

未融合：
```
gate = x @ W_gate        # [M, 16384] 写 HBM
up   = x @ W_up          # [M, 16384] 写 HBM
y    = silu(gate) * up   # 读两遍 HBM，写一遍 HBM
down = y @ W_down
```

融合后：
```
(gate, up) = x @ [W_gate; W_up]        # 单 GEMM，epilogue 直接算 silu(gate)*up
y          = epilogue 输出               # 只写一遍 HBM
down       = y @ W_down
```

- 省掉 gate、up 两个 [M, 16384] 中间 tensor 的 write + read
- M=8192 时 = 32768×16384×2B = 1 GB HBM 流量消失

**2. RoPE 融入 QKV GEMM**

未融合：QKV 先算出写 HBM，RoPE kernel 读回来做 sin/cos 旋转再写。融合后：QKV GEMM epilogue 直接在寄存器里做 RoPE 旋转，一次性写最终 q/k/v。

### 为什么对 SALA 有价值

prefill M=8192 是 memory-bandwidth-bound 中等偏 compute，每省一次 [M, 16384] 的 HBM round-trip 就是实打实的 ms 级收益。decode M=1/8 权重带宽饱和，activation 来回不是瓶颈，收益小。

### 为什么和 autotune 互补

- autotune 调的是 **mainloop 内部效率**（tile / stages / schedule），挤 MMA 利用率
- epilogue fusion 改的是 **GEMM 对外的 I/O 模式**，减总流量
- 两件事正交，可以并行推进，叠加收益
